18.10.353.d: अपां यो मध्यतो रसस् तम् अहम् अस्मा आमुष्यायणाय पुष्ट्यै प्रजननाय गृह्णामि । इत्य् आश्वत्थेन ।
18.10.353.m: 'The sap of the waters that is in the middle, that I draw for this descendant of so-and-so for thriving and procreation,' with the [vessel] made of aśvattha-wood;

18.10.353.s: apāṃ yo yajñiyo rasas tam aham asmā āmuṣyāyaṇāyāyuṣe dīrghāyutvāya gṛhṇāmi | ity audumbareṇa |
18.10.353.d: अपां यो यज्ञियो रसस् तम् अहम् अस्मा आमुष्यायणायायुषे दीर्घायुत्वाय गृह्णामि । इत्य् औदुम्बरेण ।
18.10.353.m: 'The sap of the waters that is worthy of sacrifice, that I draw for this descendant of so-and-so for lifespan and long life,' with the [vessel] made of udumbara-wood.
Then he spreads out this red ox-hide, neck to the east, hair side up.

18.10.353.s: tad yajamānaṃ prāñcam upaveśya suvarṇarajatābhyām̐ rukmābhyāṃ paryupāsyābhiṣiñcati | apāṃ yo dravaṇe rasas tenāham imam āmuṣyāyaṇaṃ tejase brahmavarcasāyābhiṣiñcāmi | iti parṇamayena |
18.10.353.d: तद् यजमानं प्राञ्चम् उपवेश्य सुवर्णरजताभ्याँ रुक्माभ्यां पर्युपास्याभिषिञ्चति । अपां यो द्रवणे रसस् तेनाहम् इमम् आमुष्यायणं तेजसे ब्रह्मवर्चसायाभिषिञ्चामि । इति पर्णमयेन ।
18.10.353.m: Having seated the sacrificer upon it facing east, having placed [ornaments of] gold and silver on both sides, he sprinkles him [with the formula]: "What sap of the waters is in the stream, with that I sprinkle this descendant of so-and-so for fiery brilliance, for holy splendor"—with the palāśa cup.

18.10.353.s: apāṃ ya ūrmau rasas tenāham imam āmuṣyāyaṇamojase vīryāyābhiṣiñcāmi | iti naiyagrodhena |
18.10.353.d: अपां य ऊर्मौ रसस् तेनाहम् इमम् आमुष्यायणमोजसे वीर्यायाभिषिञ्चामि । इति नैयग्रोधेन ।
18.10.353.m: "What sap of the waters is in the wave, with that I sprinkle this descendant of so-and-so for power, for virility"—with the nyagrodha cup.

18.10.353.s: apāṃ yo madhyato rasas tenāham imam āmuṣyāyaṇaṃ puṣṭyai prajananāyābhiṣiñcāmi | ity āśvatthena |
18.10.353.d: अपां यो मध्यतो रसस् तेनाहम् इमम् आमुष्यायणं पुष्ट्यै प्रजननायाभिषिञ्चामि । इत्य् आश्वत्थेन ।
18.10.353.m: "What sap of the waters is in the middle, with that I sprinkle this descendant of so-and-so for prosperity, for procreation"—with the aśvattha cup.

18.10.353.s: apāṃ yo yajñiyo rasas tenāham imam āmuṣyāyaṇamāyuṣe dīrghāyutvāyābhiṣiñcāmi | ity audumbareṇa
18.10.353.d: अपां यो यज्ञियो रसस् तेनाहम् इमम् आमुष्यायणमायुषे दीर्घायुत्वायाभिषिञ्चामि । इत्य् औदुम्बरेण
18.10.353.m: "What sap of the waters is fit for sacrifice, with that I sprinkle this descendant of so-and-so for life, for longevity"—with the udumbara cup.

18.10.354.s: samunmṛṣṭe samutkrośantīti samānam ā mukhasya vimārjanāt |
18.10.354.d: समुन्मृष्टे समुत्क्रोशन्तीति समानम् आ मुखस्य विमार्जनात् ।
18.10.354.m: When he is wiped, they shout together—[all this is] the same up to the wiping of the face.

18.10.354.s: uttarata etad dhūpāyitam̐ śataṃ tiṣṭhati rathaś ca
18.10.354.d: उत्तरत एतद् धूपायितँ शतं तिष्ठति रथश् च
18.10.354.m: To the north stands this fumigated [garment of] a hundred [threads] and a chariot.

18.10.354.s: tad abhipraiti | abhiprehi vīrayasva | ugraś cettā sapatnahā | ātiṣṭha mitravardhanas tubhyaṃ devā adhibravan | iti |
18.10.354.d: तद् अभिप्रैति । अभिप्रेहि वीरयस्व । उग्रश् चेत्ता सपत्नहा । आतिष्ठ मित्रवर्धनस् तुभ्यं देवा अधिब्रवन् । इति ।
18.10.354.m: He walks towards it with: "Advance, show courage! / A fierce watcher, slayer of rivals, / mount [the chariot], increaser of friends; / to thee the gods have proclaimed."

18.10.354.s: atha rathasya pakṣasī saṃmṛśati | aṅkau nyaṅkāv abhito rathaṃ yau | iti
18.10.354.d: अथ रथस्य पक्षसी संमृशति । अङ्कौ न्यङ्काव् अभितो रथं यौ । इति
18.10.354.m: Then he touches both sides of the chariot with: "The two hooks and side-hangings on both sides of the chariot which..."

18.10.354.s: ratham ātiṣṭhati | ātiṣṭha vṛtrahan | iti pratipadya | āyaṃ pṛṇaktu rajasī upastham ity ātas |
18.10.354.d: रथम् आतिष्ठति । आतिष्ठ वृत्रहन् । इति प्रतिपद्य । आयं पृणक्तु रजसी उपस्थम् इत्य् आतस् ।
18.10.354.m: He mounts the chariot, beginning with: "Mount, O slayer of Vṛtra!" up to "May this [chariot] fill the lap of both realms of air."

18.10.354.s: athaitac chataṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pariyāya puraskṛtyāyāti
18.10.354.d: अथैतच् छतं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं परियाय पुरस्कृत्यायाति
18.10.354.m: Then, having driven thrice around this hundred clockwise, placing it in front, he comes back.

18.10.354.s: tad adhvaryave dadāti sa eṣa odanasavo rājño vā brāhmaṇasya vā vaiśyasya vā puṣṭikāmasya yajñaḥ ||
18.10.354.d: तद् अध्वर्यवे ददाति स एष ओदनसवो राज्ञो वा ब्राह्मणस्य वा वैश्यस्य वा पुष्टिकामस्य यज्ञः ॥
18.10.354.m: He gives it to the adhvaryu priest. This is the odanasava sacrifice for a king, a brāhmaṇa, or a vaiśya who is desirous of prosperity.

18.11.354.s: pañcaśāradīyena yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa upakalpayate saptadaśa niraṣṭān vatsatarān ekahāyanān
18.11.354.d: पञ्चशारदीयेन यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स उपकल्पयते सप्तदश निरष्टान् वत्सतरान् एकहायनान्
18.11.354.m: One who is about to perform the Pañcaśāradīya sacrifice prepares seventeen castrated one-year-old bull-calves.

18.11.354.s: sa purastān mārgaśīrṣyai paurṇamāsyā āmāvāsyena haviṣeṣṭvā sapatadaśa mārutīḥ pṛśnīr vatsatarīr ālabhate |
18.11.354.d: स पुरस्तान् मार्गशीर्ष्यै पौर्णमास्या आमावास्येन हविषेष्ट्वा सपतदश मारुतीः पृश्नीर् वत्सतरीर् आलभते ।
18.11.354.m: Before the full moon of Mārgaśīrṣa, having sacrificed with the new-moon oblation, he seizes seventeen speckled heifer-calves for the Maruts.

18.11.354.s: abhiprokṣaṇato vatsatarān sthāpayitvotsṛjanti | athetarābhiḥ sam̐sthāṃ kurvanti
18.11.354.d: अभिप्रोक्षणतो वत्सतरान् स्थापयित्वोत्सृजन्ति । अथेतराभिः सँस्थां कुर्वन्ति
18.11.354.m: After holding the bull-calves up to the sprinkling, they release them. Then with the other [heifers] they conclude [the sacrifice].

18.11.354.s: saṃvatsare paryavete marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyaḥ saptadaśa pṛṣatīr vatsatarīr ālabhate |
18.11.354.d: संवत्सरे पर्यवेते मरुद्भ्यः सांतपनेभ्यः सप्तदश पृषतीर् वत्सतरीर् आलभते ।
18.11.354.m: When a year has elapsed, he seizes seventeen dappled heifer-calves for the Sāṃtapana Maruts.
After holding the bull-calves up to the sprinkling, they release them.

18.11.354.s: athetarābhir eva sam̐sthāṃ kurvanti dvitīye saṃvatsare paryavete marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyaḥ saptadaśa kalmāṣīr vatsatarīr ālabhate |
18.11.354.d: अथेतराभिर् एव सँस्थां कुर्वन्ति द्वितीये संवत्सरे पर्यवेते मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्यः सप्तदश कल्माषीर् वत्सतरीर् आलभते ।
18.11.354.m: Then with the other [heifers] they conclude [the sacrifice]. When the second year has elapsed, he seizes seventeen spotted heifer-calves for the Gṛhamedhin Maruts.

18.11.355.s: abhiprokṣaṇato vatsatarān sthāpayitvotsṛjanti | athetarābhir eva sam̐sthāṃ kurvanti
18.11.355.d: अभिप्रोक्षणतो वत्सतरान् स्थापयित्वोत्सृजन्ति । अथेतराभिर् एव सँस्थां कुर्वन्ति
18.11.355.m: After holding the bull-calves up to the sprinkling, they release them. Then with the other [heifers] they conclude [the sacrifice].

18.11.355.s: tṛtīye saṃvatsare paryavete marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ saptadaśāvaliptā vatsatarīr ālabhate |
18.11.355.d: तृतीये संवत्सरे पर्यवेते मरुद्भ्यः क्रीडिभ्यः सप्तदशावलिप्ता वत्सतरीर् आलभते ।
18.11.355.m: When the third year has elapsed, he seizes seventeen smudged heifer-calves for the Krīḍin Maruts.
After holding the bull-calves up to the sprinkling, they release them.

18.11.355.s: athetarābhir eva sam̐sthāṃ kurvanti caturthe saṃvatsare paryavete marudbhyaḥ svatavadbhyaḥ saptadaśa rājīvā vatsatarīr ālabhate |
18.11.355.d: अथेतराभिर् एव सँस्थां कुर्वन्ति चतुर्थे संवत्सरे पर्यवेते मरुद्भ्यः स्वतवद्भ्यः सप्तदश राजीवा वत्सतरीर् आलभते ।
18.11.355.m: Then with the other [heifers] they conclude [the sacrifice]. When the fourth year has elapsed, he seizes seventeen striped heifer-calves for the Svatavat Maruts.

18.11.355.s: abhiprokṣaṇato vatsatarān sthāpayitvotsṛjanti | athetarābhir eva sam̐sthāṃ kurvanti |
18.11.355.d: अभिप्रोक्षणतो वत्सतरान् स्थापयित्वोत्सृजन्ति । अथेतराभिर् एव सँस्थां कुर्वन्ति ।
18.11.355.m: After holding the bull-calves up to the sprinkling, they release them. Then with the other [heifers] they conclude [the sacrifice].

18.11.355.s: etad evāhar dīkṣate saṃvatsaram ukhyaṃ bibharti
18.11.355.d: एतद् एवाहर् दीक्षते संवत्सरम् उख्यं बिभर्ति
18.11.355.m: On that very day he undergoes consecration. He maintains the fire in the pan for a year.

18.11.355.s: dvādaśopasadas tasyāhāni trivṛdagniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ saptadaśa ukthyaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ saptadaśo 'tirātras
18.11.355.d: द्वादशोपसदस् तस्याहानि त्रिवृदग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः सप्तदश उक्थ्यः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः सप्तदशो ऽतिरात्रस्
18.11.355.m: There are twelve upasads. Its days are: a trivṛt agniṣṭoma, a fifteen-versed ukthya, a seventeen-versed ukthya, a fifteen-versed ukthya, and a seventeen-versed atirātra.

18.11.355.s: tasya māruta stomo bhavati | athaiteṣāṃ paśūnāṃ trayaḥ prathame 'hann aindrāmārutā ukṣāṇaḥ savanīyā ālabhyante |
18.11.355.d: तस्य मारुत स्तोमो भवति । अथैतेषां पशूनां त्रयः प्रथमे ऽहन्न् ऐन्द्रामारुता उक्षाणः सवनीया आलभ्यन्ते ।
18.11.355.m: Its chant belongs to the Maruts. Then, of these animals, three oxen belonging to Indra and the Maruts are seized on the first day as sacrificial animals for the pressing.

18.11.355.s: evaṃ dvitīya evaṃ tṛtīya evaṃ caturthe
18.11.355.d: एवं द्वितीय एवं तृतीय एवं चतुर्थे
18.11.355.m: In this manner on the second, in this manner on the third, in this manner on the fourth.

18.11.355.s: pañcottame 'hann ālabhyante varṣiṣṭham iva hy etad ahar manyante varṣiṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ bhavati | iti brāhmaṇam
18.11.355.d: पञ्चोत्तमे ऽहन्न् आलभ्यन्ते वर्षिष्ठम् इव ह्य् एतद् अहर् मन्यन्ते वर्षिष्ठः समानानां भवति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
18.11.355.m: Five are seized on the last day. "For they consider this day as if it were the highest; he becomes the highest among his equals," so says the brāhmaṇa passage.

18.11.355.s: athaiteṣāṃ paśūnāṃ yadi naśyati mriyate vā yāśvamedhe prāyaścittis tāṃ kṛtvāthānyaṃ taddaivatyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tajjātīyaṃ paśum ālabhante
18.11.355.d: अथैतेषां पशूनां यदि नश्यति म्रियते वा याश्वमेधे प्रायश्चित्तिस् तां कृत्वाथान्यं तद्दैवत्यं तद्रूपं तज्जातीयं पशुम् आलभन्ते
18.11.355.m: Then, if any of these animals is lost or dies, having performed that expiation which is prescribed in the Aśvamedha, they seize another animal of the same divinity, of the same appearance, and of the same kind.

18.11.355.s: sa eṣa pañcaśāradīyo rājño vā brāhmaṇasya vā yaḥ kāmayeta bahor bhūyān syām iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta
18.11.355.d: स एष पञ्चशारदीयो राज्ञो वा ब्राह्मणस्य वा यः कामयेत बहोर् भूयान् स्याम् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत
18.11.355.m: This is the Pañcaśāradīya for a king or a brāhmaṇa. "Whoever should desire, 'May I become greater than many,' he should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite."

18.12.356.s: agniṣṭutā yakṣyamāṇo bhavati tasya sarvam eva samānam |
18.12.356.d: अग्निष्टुता यक्ष्यमाणो भवति तस्य सर्वम् एव समानम् ।
18.12.356.m: One is about to sacrifice with the Agniṣṭut. In its case, everything is the same.

18.12.356.s: puroruca evānyās | asyājarāsas | agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase | ity aindravāyavasya
18.12.356.d: पुरोरुच एवान्यास् । अस्याजरासस् । अग्न आयूँषि पवसे । इत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवस्य
18.12.356.m: Only the puroruc verses are different: "His unaging [flames]...", "O Agni, thou purifiest lives..."—for the cup for Indra and Vāyu.

18.12.356.s: yajā no mitrāvaruṇā | iti maitrāvaruṇasya | aśvinā pibatam̐ sutam ity āśvinasya
18.12.356.d: यजा नो मित्रावरुणा । इति मैत्रावरुणस्य । अश्विना पिबतँ सुतम् इत्य् आश्विनस्य
18.12.356.m: "Sacrifice for us to Mitra and Varuṇa..."—for that of Maitrāvaruṇa; "O Aśvins, drink the pressed [soma]..."—for that of the Aśvins.

18.12.356.s: dve virūpe carataḥ pūrvāparaṃ carato māyayaitau | iti śukrāmanthinos
18.12.356.d: द्वे विरूपे चरतः पूर्वापरं चरतो माययैतौ । इति शुक्रामन्थिनोस्
18.12.356.m: "Two of different forms wander...", "The earlier and the later wander by magic..."—for the Śukra and Manthin cups.

18.12.356.s: trīṇi śatā trī ṣahasrāṇy agnim ity āgrayaṇasya
18.12.356.d: त्रीणि शता त्री षहस्राण्य् अग्निम् इत्य् आग्रयणस्य
18.12.356.m: "Three hundred, three thousand to Agni..."—for the Āgrayaṇa cup.

18.12.356.s: niyunakty ukthyasya nityā dhruvasya | agnināgniḥ samidhyate | ity aindrāgnasya |
18.12.356.d: नियुनक्त्य् उक्थ्यस्य नित्या ध्रुवस्य । अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते । इत्य् ऐन्द्राग्नस्य ।
18.12.356.m: He assigns [a verse] for the ukthya cup. The customary one is for the Dhruva cup. "By fire is fire kindled..."—for that for Indra and Agni.

18.12.356.s: agnir devānāṃ jaṭharam iti vaiśvadevasya | agniśriyas | yad uttame | īḍe agnim̐ svavasam iti tisro marutvatīyānām |
18.12.356.d: अग्निर् देवानां जठरम् इति वैश्वदेवस्य । अग्निश्रियस् । यद् उत्तमे । ईडे अग्निँ स्ववसम् इति तिस्रो मरुत्वतीयानाम् ।
18.12.356.m: "Agni is the belly of the gods..."—for that for the All-gods. "Glorified by Agni...", "When in the highest...", "I praise Agni who gives good protection..." are the three for the Marutvatīya cups.
"Hear, O thou whose ear heareth, along with the conveyers..."—for the Māhendra cup.

18.12.356.s: viśveṣām aditir yajñiyānām | tve agne tvām agne | iti tisra ādityasya grahasya
18.12.356.d: विश्वेषाम् अदितिर् यज्ञियानाम् । त्वे अग्ने त्वाम् अग्ने । इति तिस्र आदित्यस्य ग्रहस्य
18.12.356.m: "Aditi of all who are worthy of sacrifice...", "In thee, O Agni...", "Thee, O Agni..." are the three for the Āditya cup.

18.12.356.s: ni tvā yajñasya sādhanam iti sāvitrasya
18.12.356.d: नि त्वा यज्ञस्य साधनम् इति सावित्रस्य
18.12.356.m: "Thee who effectest the sacrifice..."—for the Sāvitra cup.
The customary one is for the Pātnīvata cup. He assigns [a verse] for the Hāriyojana cup.

18.12.356.s: sa eṣa trivṛdagniṣṭut pavitram | yathā ha vā idaṃ dāvādabhidūnā abhivṛṣṭāḥ punarṇavā oṣadhayo samuttiṣṭhanty evam̐ ha vā eṣa etena yajñakratuneṣṭvā śuciḥ pūto medhyo bhavati
18.12.356.d: स एष त्रिवृदग्निष्टुत् पवित्रम् । यथा ह वा इदं दावादभिदूना अभिवृष्टाः पुनर्णवा ओषधयो समुत्तिष्ठन्त्य् एवँ ह वा एष एतेन यज्ञक्रतुनेष्ट्वा शुचिः पूतो मेध्यो भवति
18.12.356.m: This nine-versed Agniṣṭut is a purifier. Just as here herbs scorched by a forest fire and rained upon rise up renewed, so indeed does he, having sacrificed with this sacrificial rite, become clean, purified, and worthy of sacrifice.

18.12.356.s: sa yadi mukhena pāpakṛn manyeta trivṛtaṃ kurvīta | eṣa ha vai mukhena pāpaṃ karoti yo 'nūcānasya vā muner vā duravagatam avagacchati
18.12.356.d: स यदि मुखेन पापकृन् मन्येत त्रिवृतं कुर्वीत । एष ह वै मुखेन पापं करोति यो ऽनूचानस्य वा मुनेर् वा दुरवगतम् अवगच्छति
18.12.356.m: If he should consider himself to have committed evil by the mouth, he should perform it nine-versed. He indeed commits evil by the mouth who disparages what has been ill-understood by a learned man or a sage.

18.12.357.s: yadi bāhubhyāṃ pañcadaśaṃ kurvīta | eṣa ha vai bāhubhyāṃ pāpaṃ karoti yo brāhmaṇāyodyacchate
18.12.357.d: यदि बाहुभ्यां पञ्चदशं कुर्वीत । एष ह वै बाहुभ्यां पापं करोति यो ब्राह्मणायोद्यच्छते
18.12.357.m: If by the arms, he should perform it fifteen-versed. He indeed commits evil by the arms who raises [his hand] against a brāhmaṇa.
If by the belly, he should perform it seventeen-versed.

18.12.357.s: eṣa ha vā udareṇa pāpaṃ karoti yo 'nāśyānnasyānnam aśnāti
18.12.357.d: एष ह वा उदरेण पापं करोति यो ऽनाश्यान्नस्यान्नम् अश्नाति
18.12.357.m: He indeed commits evil by the belly who eats the food of someone whose food is not to be eaten.

18.12.357.s: yadi padbhyām ekavim̐śaṃ kurvīta | eṣa ha vai padbhyāṃ pāpaṃ karoti ||
18.12.357.d: यदि पद्भ्याम् एकविँशं कुर्वीत । एष ह वै पद्भ्यां पापं करोति ॥
18.12.357.m: If by the feet, he should perform it twenty-one-versed. He indeed commits evil by the feet,

18.13.357.s: ya āraṭṭān vā gāndhārān vā sauvīrān vā karaskarān vā kaliṅgān vā gacchati
18.13.357.d: य आरट्टान् वा गान्धारान् वा सौवीरान् वा करस्करान् वा कलिङ्गान् वा गच्छति
18.13.357.m: who goes to the Āraṭṭas, the Gāndhāras, the Sauvīras, the Karaskaras, or the Kaliṅgas.

18.13.357.s: sa yadi sarvaśa eva pāpakṛn manyeta catuṣṭomenāgniṣṭomena yajeta
18.13.357.d: स यदि सर्वश एव पापकृन् मन्येत चतुष्टोमेनाग्निष्टोमेन यजेत
18.13.357.m: If he should consider himself to have committed evil altogether, he should sacrifice with the four-stoma agniṣṭoma.

18.13.357.s: tena haitenartuparṇo bhāṅgāśvina īje śaphālānām̐ rājā
18.13.357.d: तेन हैतेनर्तुपर्णो भाङ्गाश्विन ईजे शफालानाँ राजा
18.13.357.m: "With this very [sacrifice] Ṛtuparṇa Bhāṅgāśvina, the king of the Śaphālas, sacrificed.

18.13.357.s: tena heṣṭvā gṛgayām abhiprayayau tam̐ hendro 'nukhyāyaivekṣāṃ cakre 'ham u tvā tad yātaye yan mā yajñakrator antarāya iti
18.13.357.d: तेन हेष्ट्वा गृगयाम् अभिप्रययौ तँ हेन्द्रो ऽनुख्यायैवेक्षां चक्रे ऽहम् उ त्वा तद् यातये यन् मा यज्ञक्रतोर् अन्तराय इति
18.13.357.m: Having sacrificed with it, he set out for hunting. Having perceived him, Indra thought: 'I shall make you atone for having excluded me from the sacrificial rite!'

18.13.357.s: sa ha svin na udakam abhyaveyāya tam̐ ha tatraiva striyaṃ cakāra
18.13.357.d: स ह स्विन् न उदकम् अभ्यवेयाय तँ ह तत्रैव स्त्रियं चकार
18.13.357.m: He went down into the water. [Indra] turned him into a woman right there."

18.13.357.s: sā sudevalā nāmāsa sā haitad eva rāṣṭram abhyāruroha
18.13.357.d: सा सुदेवला नामास सा हैतद् एव राष्ट्रम् अभ्यारुरोह
18.13.357.m: She was named Sudevalā. She then entered upon that very kingdom.

18.13.357.s: sā strī satī putrān janayāṃ cakāra tebhyo hendraḥ samadaṃ dadhau
18.13.357.d: सा स्त्री सती पुत्रान् जनयां चकार तेभ्यो हेन्द्रः समदं दधौ
18.13.357.m: Being a woman, she gave birth to sons. Indra set strife among them.

18.13.357.s: te hatā vidṛḍhāḥ śiśyire tān ubhayān antareṇa rudantyāsāṃ cakre |
18.13.357.d: ते हता विदृढाः शिश्यिरे तान् उभयान् अन्तरेण रुदन्त्यासां चक्रे ।
18.13.357.m: They lay dead and crushed. Between both [sides], she sat weeping.

18.13.358.s: atho hendra ājagāma tām u hābhyupeyāya
18.13.358.d: अथो हेन्द्र आजगाम ताम् उ हाभ्युपेयाय
18.13.358.m: Then Indra came. He approached her.

18.13.358.s: tām̐ hovāca sudevalā3 iti bhagava iti
18.13.358.d: ताँ होवाच सुदेवला३ इति भगव इति
18.13.358.m: He said to her: 'Sudevalā!' [She replied:] 'O venerable one!'

18.13.358.s: priyaṃ tavaitad iti kiṃ me bhagavaḥ priyaṃ bhavaiṣyatīti | evaṃ vai mama tad apriyam āsīd yan mā yajñakrator antarāyo vṛṇīṣva nu yatare te putrā jīveyur iti
18.13.358.d: प्रियं तवैतद् इति किं मे भगवः प्रियं भवैष्यतीति । एवं वै मम तद् अप्रियम् आसीद् यन् मा यज्ञक्रतोर् अन्तरायो वृणीष्व नु यतरे ते पुत्रा जीवेयुर् इति
18.13.358.m: 'Is this dear to you?' [She said:] 'What would be dear to me, O venerable one?' [He said:] 'Thus indeed was it displeasing to me that you shut me out from the sacrificial rite. Choose now which of your sons should live.'

18.13.358.s: yān eva bhagava strī saty adhyagamam iti hovāca
18.13.358.d: यान् एव भगव स्त्री सत्य् अध्यगमम् इति होवाच
18.13.358.m: 'Those very ones, O venerable one, whom I obtained when I was a woman,' she said.

18.13.358.s: tasmād āhuḥ striyāḥ putrāḥ preyām̐so bhavantīti
18.13.358.d: तस्माद् आहुः स्त्रियाः पुत्राः प्रेयाँसो भवन्तीति
18.13.358.m: Therefore they say: 'The sons of a woman are dearer.'

18.13.358.s: sa etasminn eva pūrvapakṣe catuṣṭomenāgniṣṭomena yajeta purā bhreṣāc chāntyai ||
18.13.358.d: स एतस्मिन्न् एव पूर्वपक्षे चतुष्टोमेनाग्निष्टोमेन यजेत पुरा भ्रेषाच् छान्त्यै ॥
18.13.358.m: In that very first fortnight [of the waxing moon], one should sacrifice with the four-stoma agniṣṭoma before failure [occurs], for appeasement.

18.14.358.s: indrastutā yakṣyamāṇo bhavati tasya sarvam eva samānaṃ puroruca evānyās
18.14.358.d: इन्द्रस्तुता यक्ष्यमाणो भवति तस्य सर्वम् एव समानं पुरोरुच एवान्यास्
18.14.358.m: One is about to sacrifice with the indrastut. Everything of it is identical; only the puroruc formulas are different.

18.14.358.s: tiṣṭhā harī kasya vṛṣā sute sacā | ity aindravāyavasya | indraṃ vayaṃ mahādhane | iti maitrāvaruṇasya
18.14.358.d: तिष्ठा हरी कस्य वृषा सुते सचा । इत्य् ऐन्द्रवायवस्य । इन्द्रं वयं महाधने । इति मैत्रावरुणस्य
18.14.358.m: 'Stand, O pair of bay steeds,' [and] 'In whose pressed [soma] does the bull [rejoice] together?'—for that of Indra and Vāyu; 'Indra do we in the great contest'—for that of Mitra and Varuṇa;
'He who twice over is the greatest slayer of Vṛtra'—for that of the Aśvins;

18.14.358.s: sa sūra ājanayañ jyotir indram uta tyad āśvaśviyam iti śukrāmanthinos |
18.14.358.d: स सूर आजनयञ् ज्योतिर् इन्द्रम् उत त्यद् आश्वश्वियम् इति शुक्रामन्थिनोस् ।
18.14.358.m: 'He in the sun generated the light, Indra' [and] 'And that swift courser-like'—for the śukra and manthin [cups];

18.14.358.s: bhareṣv indram ity āgrayaṇasya nityokthyasya niyunakti dhruvasya
18.14.358.d: भरेष्व् इन्द्रम् इत्य् आग्रयणस्य नित्योक्थ्यस्य नियुनक्ति ध्रुवस्य
18.14.358.m: 'Indra in the contests'—for the āgrayaṇa [cup]; the customary one for the ukthya [cup]; he fastens [the verse] for the dhruva [cup];

18.14.358.s: mahi kṣetraṃ puruś candram ity aindrāgnasya | uruṃ no lokam anuneṣi vidvān iti vaiśvadevasya
18.14.358.d: महि क्षेत्रं पुरुश् चन्द्रम् इत्य् ऐन्द्राग्नस्य । उरुं नो लोकम् अनुनेषि विद्वान् इति वैश्वदेवस्य
18.14.358.m: 'A great, wide, gleaming field'—for that of Indra and Agni; 'Knowing, lead us to a wide realm'—for that of the All-gods;
the customary ones for the marutvatīya cups; the customary one for the māhendra [cup];

18.14.359.s: ā no viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ kadācana starīr asi | indrāya gāva āśiram iti tisra ādityasya grahasya |
18.14.359.d: आ नो विश्वाभिर् ऊतिभिः कदाचन स्तरीर् असि । इन्द्राय गाव आशिरम् इति तिस्र आदित्यस्य ग्रहस्य ।
18.14.359.m: 'To us with all your aids,' 'Never are you barren,' [and] 'For Indra the cows [give] milk-mixture'—these three for the cup to Āditya;
'This thought of yours'—for that to Savitar;
he fastens [the verse] for the pātnīvata cup; the customary one for the hāriyojana [cup].

18.14.359.s: sa eṣa pañcadaśa indrastud indriyakāmasya yo vā jyeṣṭhabandhur apabhūtaḥ syāt sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta |
18.14.359.d: स एष पञ्चदश इन्द्रस्तुद् इन्द्रियकामस्य यो वा ज्येष्ठबन्धुर् अपभूतः स्यात् स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत ।
18.14.359.m: This is the fifteenfold indrastut for one who desires power. Or whoever, being the eldest among his brothers, is overthrown, he should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite.
He indeed attains the eldest status.

18.15.359.s: aptoryāmeṇa yakṣyamāṇo bhavati dīkṣate tasyāparimitā dīkṣā dvādaśopasadas
18.15.359.d: अप्तोर्यामेण यक्ष्यमाणो भवति दीक्षते तस्यापरिमिता दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदस्
18.15.359.m: One is about to sacrifice with the aptoryāma. He consecrates himself. His consecration is of unmeasured duration; there are twelve upasad days.

18.15.359.s: trivṛdbahiṣpavamānaḥ pañcadaśam̐ hotur ājyam̐ saptadaśaṃ maitrāvaruṇasyaikavim̐śaṃ brāhmaṇāccham̐sinas triṇavam acchāvākasya
18.15.359.d: त्रिवृद्बहिष्पवमानः पञ्चदशँ होतुर् आज्यँ सप्तदशं मैत्रावरुणस्यैकविँशं ब्राह्मणाच्छँसिनस् त्रिणवम् अच्छावाकस्य
18.15.359.m: The bahiṣpavamāna chant is ninefold; the hotṛ's ājyastotra is fifteenfold; that of the maitrāvaruṇa is seventeenfold; that of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin is twenty-onefold; that of the acchāvāka is twenty-sevenfold.

18.15.359.s: trayastrim̐śo mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānas | caturvim̐śam̐ hotuḥ pṛṣṭham̐ rathaṃtaraṃ ca vairājaṃ ca sāmanī anyatareṇānyatarat pariṣṭuvanti
18.15.359.d: त्रयस्त्रिँशो माध्यंदिनः पवमानस् । चतुर्विँशँ होतुः पृष्ठँ रथंतरं च वैराजं च सामनी अन्यतरेणान्यतरत् परिष्टुवन्ति
18.15.359.m: The midday pavamāna chant is thirty-threefold. The pṛṣṭhastotra of the hotṛ is twenty-fourfold; the rathaṃtara and vairāja are the two samans; they chant the one around the other.

18.15.359.s: catuścatvārim̐śaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya vāmadevyaṃ ca śakvaraṃ ca sāmanī anyatareṇānyatarat pariṣṭuvanti |
18.15.359.d: चतुश्चत्वारिँशं मैत्रावरुणस्य वामदेव्यं च शक्वरं च सामनी अन्यतरेणान्यतरत् परिष्टुवन्ति ।
18.15.359.m: [The pṛṣṭhastotra] of the maitrāvaruṇa is forty-fourfold; the vāmadevya and śakvara are the two samans; they chant the one around the other.

18.15.359.s: aṣṭācatvārim̐śaṃ brāhmaṇāccham̐sino naudhasaṃ ca vairūpaṃ ca sāmanī anyatareṇānyatarat pariṣṭuvanti |
18.15.359.d: अष्टाचत्वारिँशं ब्राह्मणाच्छँसिनो नौधसं च वैरूपं च सामनी अन्यतरेणान्यतरत् परिष्टुवन्ति ।
18.15.359.m: [The pṛṣṭhastotra] of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin is forty-eightfold; the naudhasa and vairūpa are the two samans; they chant the one around the other.

18.15.359.s: ekavim̐śamacchāvākasya kāleyaṃ ca raivataṃ ca sāmanī anyatareṇānyatarat pariṣṭuvanti
18.15.359.d: एकविँशमच्छावाकस्य कालेयं च रैवतं च सामनी अन्यतरेणान्यतरत् परिष्टुवन्ति
18.15.359.m: [The pṛṣṭhastotra] of the acchāvāka is twenty-onefold; the kāleya and raivata are the two samans; they chant the one around the other.

18.15.359.s: tam etam aṣṭāpṛṣṭha iti chandogā ācakṣate
18.15.359.d: तम् एतम् अष्टापृष्ठ इति छन्दोगा आचक्षते
18.15.359.m: This very [ritual] the Sāmavedins call the eight-pṛṣṭha.

18.15.359.s: triṇava ārbhavaḥ pavamānas trayastrim̐śam agniṣṭomasāmaikavim̐śāny ukthyāni saṣoḍaśikāni pañcadaśānītarāṇi trivṛdrāthaṃtaraḥ sandhis
18.15.359.d: त्रिणव आर्भवः पवमानस् त्रयस्त्रिँशम् अग्निष्टोमसामैकविँशान्य् उक्थ्यानि सषोडशिकानि पञ्चदशानीतराणि त्रिवृद्राथंतरः सन्धिस्
18.15.359.m: The ārbhava-pavamāna chant is twenty-sevenfold; the agniṣṭoma-sāman is thirty-threefold; the ukthya [chants] are twenty-onefold; those with the ṣoḍaśin [cup] are fifteenfold; the other [stotras] are ninefold; the sandhi-stotra is on the rathaṃtara saman.

18.15.360.s: tat kṣudrāḥ paśavo 'tiśeduḥ somo vā etad atiricyamāna iyāya
18.15.360.d: तत् क्षुद्राः पशवो ऽतिशेदुः सोमो वा एतद् अतिरिच्यमान इयाय
18.15.360.m: Small cattle then remained over. 'Soma, overflowing, went forth [as cattle].'

18.15.360.s: te devā abruvann aptor vā ayam atyareci tasya ko yāma iti
18.15.360.d: ते देवा अब्रुवन्न् अप्तोर् वा अयम् अत्यरेचि तस्य को याम इति
18.15.360.m: 'Those gods said: "He has overflowed beyond the ritual act; what course is there for him?"'
'That is the aptoryāma-nature of the aptoryāma.'

18.15.360.s: tasmā etāny atiriktastrotrāṇy avakalpayāṃ cakrus trivṛddh otur jarābodhīyaṃ pañcadaśaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya sauhaviṣam̐ saptadaśaṃ brāhmaṇāccham̐sina udvam̐śīyam ekavim̐śam acchāvākasya vāravantīyam |
18.15.360.d: तस्मा एतान्य् अतिरिक्तस्त्रोत्राण्य् अवकल्पयां चक्रुस् त्रिवृद्ध् ओतुर् जराबोधीयं पञ्चदशं मैत्रावरुणस्य सौहविषँ सप्तदशं ब्राह्मणाच्छँसिन उद्वँशीयम् एकविँशम् अच्छावाकस्य वारवन्तीयम् ।
18.15.360.m: For it they arranged these extra chants: a ninefold jarābodhīya [saman] for the hotṛ; a fifteenfold sauhaviṣa for the maitrāvaruṇa; a seventeenfold udvaṃśīya for the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; a twenty-onefold vāravantīya for the acchāvāka.

18.15.360.s: tad u vā āhus | yad acchāvākacamasam anu yajñaḥ saṃtiṣṭhetāntaṃ yajñaṃ gamayet |
18.15.360.d: तद् उ वा आहुस् । यद् अच्छावाकचमसम् अनु यज्ञः संतिष्ठेतान्तं यज्ञं गमयेत् ।
18.15.360.m: Moreover they say: 'If the sacrifice should conclude after the acchāvāka's cup, it would drive the sacrifice to an end;

18.15.360.s: atho hāntaṃ yajamāno gāmukaḥ syāt | hotra eva stuvīran hotānuśam̐syāt tathā mdhyato yajñaḥ samādhīyate | iti
18.15.360.d: अथो हान्तं यजमानो गामुकः स्यात् । होत्र एव स्तुवीरन् होतानुशँस्यात् तथा म्ध्यतो यज्ञः समाधीयते । इति
18.15.360.m: and then the sacrificer would be prone to perish. They should chant at the hotṛ's [post] alone; the hotṛ should recite after [it]; thus the sacrifice is maintained in the middle.'

18.15.360.s: tad u vā āhuḥ sarvāṇy evāśvināni stutaśastrāṇi syus |
18.15.360.d: तद् उ वा आहुः सर्वाण्य् एवाश्विनानि स्तुतशस्त्राणि स्युस् ।
18.15.360.m: Moreover they say: 'All the chants and recitations should belong to the Aśvins.'

18.15.360.s: yad dha kiṃca rātrim upātiricyate sarvaṃ tad āśvinam iti nv ekam
18.15.360.d: यद् ध किंच रात्रिम् उपातिरिच्यते सर्वं तद् आश्विनम् इति न्व् एकम्
18.15.360.m: 'Whatever is left over towards the night, all that belongs to the Aśvins'—this is one view.
Then the other: ninefold, fifteenfold, seventeenfold, twenty-onefold.

18.15.361.s: athaiteṣāṃ devatā agnir indro viśve devā viṣṇur iti ||
18.15.361.d: अथैतेषां देवता अग्निर् इन्द्रो विश्वे देवा विष्णुर् इति ॥
18.15.361.m: Now the deities of these are Agni, Indra, the All-gods, and Viṣṇu.

18.16.361.s: mṛtyusavena yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa upakalpayate śārdūlacarma suvarṇarajatau ca rukmau vaiyāghryāv upānahau cārmapakṣyāv upānahau vṛṣṇivāsasaṃ ca kṣaumaṃ ca tisṛdhanvam āsandīm̐ sādhīvāsaṃ dundubhiṃ vimitam audumbaraṃ droṇaṃ catuḥsrakti catuṣṭayīr apo digbhyaḥ saṃbhṛtāḥ śataṃ ca rathaṃ ca |
18.16.361.d: मृत्युसवेन यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स उपकल्पयते शार्दूलचर्म सुवर्णरजतौ च रुक्मौ वैयाघ्र्याव् उपानहौ चार्मपक्ष्याव् उपानहौ वृष्णिवाससं च क्षौमं च तिसृधन्वम् आसन्दीँ साधीवासं दुन्दुभिं विमितम् औदुम्बरं द्रोणं चतुःस्रक्ति चतुष्टयीर् अपो दिग्भ्यः संभृताः शतं च रथं च ।
18.16.361.m: One is going to sacrifice with the Mṛtyusava. He prepares a tiger skin, a gold and a silver plate, tiger-skin shoes, leather-winged shoes, a ram's wool garment, a linen garment, a three-arrowed bow, a throne-seat with an upper cover, a drum, a tent, a four-cornered wooden trough made of udumbara wood, waters gathered from four quarters, a hundred [cows], and a chariot.
With this prepared, he pauses before the approaching Citrā [full moon].

18.16.361.s: atha citrayā | iti pūrvāgnim anvavasyaty uttapanīyam̐ śālīno 'nvāhāryapacanam āhitāgnis |
18.16.361.d: अथ चित्रया । इति पूर्वाग्निम् अन्ववस्यत्य् उत्तपनीयँ शालीनो ऽन्वाहार्यपचनम् आहिताग्निस् ।
18.16.361.m: Then with the [formula mentioning] Citrā, he establishes the ancient fire: the householder [establishes] the uttapanīya fire, the keeper of sacred fires the anvāhāryapacana fire.

18.16.361.s: athānvārabdhe yajamāne juhoti vyāghro 'yam agnau carati praviṣṭas | iti ṣaṭ sruvāhutīs |
18.16.361.d: अथान्वारब्धे यजमाने जुहोति व्याघ्रो ऽयम् अग्नौ चरति प्रविष्टस् । इति षट् स्रुवाहुतीस् ।
18.16.361.m: Then, while the sacrificer holds onto him from behind, he offers six ladle libations with: 'This tiger, entered, moves in the fire.'

18.16.361.s: atha yajamānāyatane śārdūlacarma prācīnagrīvam uttaralomopastṛṇāti yat te śilpaṃ kaśyapa rocanāvat | indriyāvat puṣkalaṃ citrabhānu | yasmint sūryā arpitāḥ sapta sākam | tasmin rājānam adhiviśrayemam iti |
18.16.361.d: अथ यजमानायतने शार्दूलचर्म प्राचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमोपस्तृणाति यत् ते शिल्पं कश्यप रोचनावत् । इन्द्रियावत् पुष्कलं चित्रभानु । यस्मिन्त् सूर्या अर्पिताः सप्त साकम् । तस्मिन् राजानम् अधिविश्रयेमम् इति ।
18.16.361.m: Then at the sacrificer's place he spreads a tiger skin with the neck to the east and the hair upward, with: 'That craft of yours, O Kaśyapa, full of brightness, / possessing power, abundant, with variegated luster, / in which the seven suns are placed together, / upon that let them place this king.'

18.16.361.s: atha vaiyāghryāv upānahāv upamuñcate dyaur asi | iti dakṣiṇe pāde pṛthivy asi | ity uttare |
18.16.361.d: अथ वैयाघ्र्याव् उपानहाव् उपमुञ्चते द्यौर् असि । इति दक्षिणे पादे पृथिव्य् असि । इत्य् उत्तरे ।
18.16.361.m: Then he puts on two tiger-skin shoes with: 'You are heaven' on the right foot, with: 'You are earth' on the left.

18.16.362.s: atha dakṣiṇaṃ jānvācyābhisarpati vyāghro vaiyāghre 'dhi viśrayasva diśo mahīḥ | viśas tvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvad rāṣṭram adhi bhrāśat | iti |
18.16.362.d: अथ दक्षिणं जान्वाच्याभिसर्पति व्याघ्रो वैयाघ्रे ऽधि विश्रयस्व दिशो महीः । विशस् त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा त्वद् राष्ट्रम् अधि भ्राशत् । इति ।
18.16.362.m: Then, bending the right knee, he creeps forward with: 'A tiger upon the tiger[-skin], / mount the great quarters; / let all the clans desire you; / let not the realm slip away from you.'

18.16.362.s: athāsmai dhanuḥ prayacchati yathā rājasūye tathā tad yajamānaṃ prāñcam upaveśya suvarṇarajatābhyām̐ rukmābhyāṃ paryupāsyaudumbare droṇe catuṣṭayīr apaḥ samavanīyābhiṣiñcati ||
18.16.362.d: अथास्मै धनुः प्रयच्छति यथा राजसूये तथा तद् यजमानं प्राञ्चम् उपवेश्य सुवर्णरजताभ्याँ रुक्माभ्यां पर्युपास्यौदुम्बरे द्रोणे चतुष्टयीर् अपः समवनीयाभिषिञ्चति ॥
18.16.362.m: Then he hands him the bow just as in the rājasūya. Having seated the sacrificer facing east, having attended him with two gold and silver plates, and having gathered the fourfold waters into a trough of udumbara wood, he consecrates him [with anointment]:

18.17.362.s: yā divyā āpaḥ payasā saṃbabhūvus | yā antarikṣa uta pārthivīr yāḥ | tāsāṃ tvā sarvāsām̐ rucā | abhiṣiñcāmi varcasā ||
18.17.362.d: या दिव्या आपः पयसा संबभूवुस् । या अन्तरिक्ष उत पार्थिवीर् याः । तासां त्वा सर्वासाँ रुचा । अभिषिञ्चामि वर्चसा ॥
18.17.362.m: 'The heavenly waters that came into being with milk, / those that are in the intermediate space and those that are earthly— / with the brilliance of all of them, / with splendor I consecrate you.

18.17.362.s: abhi tvā varcasāsicam | divyena payasā saha | yathāsā rāṣṭravardhanas tathā tvā savitā karat ||
18.17.362.d: अभि त्वा वर्चसासिचम् । दिव्येन पयसा सह । यथासा राष्ट्रवर्धनस् तथा त्वा सविता करत् ॥
18.17.362.m: I have sprinkled you with splendor, / together with heavenly milk, / so that you will be an expander of the realm; / thus may Savitar make you.

18.17.362.s: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan | samudravyacasaṃ giraḥ | rathītamam̐ rathīnām | vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim ||
18.17.362.d: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन् । समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः । रथीतमँ रथीनाम् । वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम् ॥
18.17.362.m: All songs have magnified Indra, / who is wide as the sea, / the best charioteer among charioteers, / the true lord, master of prizes.'

18.17.362.s: vasavas tvā purastād abhiṣiñcantu gāyatreṇa chandasā | iti purastāt |
18.17.362.d: वसवस् त्वा पुरस्ताद् अभिषिञ्चन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसा । इति पुरस्तात् ।
18.17.362.m: From the east [he sprinkles] with: 'May the Vasus consecrate you from the east with the gāyatrī metre.'

18.17.362.s: etā eva tisro 'nudrutya rudrās tvā dakṣiṇato 'bhiṣiñcantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā | iti dakṣiṇatas |
18.17.362.d: एता एव तिस्रो ऽनुद्रुत्य रुद्रास् त्वा दक्षिणतो ऽभिषिञ्चन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा । इति दक्षिणतस् ।
18.17.362.m: Having recited these same three [verses], from the south [he sprinkles] with: 'May the Rudras consecrate you from the south with the triṣṭubh metre.'

18.17.362.s: etā eva tisro 'nudrutya | ādityās tvā paścād abhiṣiñcantu jāgatena chandasā | iti paścāt |
18.17.362.d: एता एव तिस्रो ऽनुद्रुत्य । आदित्यास् त्वा पश्चाद् अभिषिञ्चन्तु जागतेन छन्दसा । इति पश्चात् ।
18.17.362.m: Having recited these same three [verses], from the west [he sprinkles] with: 'May the Ādityas consecrate you from the west with the jagatī metre.'

18.17.362.s: etā eva tisro 'nudrutya viśve tvā devā uttarato 'bhiṣiñcantv ānuṣṭubhena chandasā | ity uttaratas |
18.17.362.d: एता एव तिस्रो ऽनुद्रुत्य विश्वे त्वा देवा उत्तरतो ऽभिषिञ्चन्त्व् आनुष्टुभेन छन्दसा । इत्य् उत्तरतस् ।
18.17.362.m: Having recited these same three [verses, he sprinkles him] from the north with: 'May the All-gods sprinkle you from the north with the anuṣṭubh meter!'

18.17.362.s: etā eva tisro 'nudrutya bṛhaspatis tvopariṣṭād abhiṣiñcatu pāṅktena chandasā | ity upariṣṭāt |
18.17.362.d: एता एव तिस्रो ऽनुद्रुत्य बृहस्पतिस् त्वोपरिष्टाद् अभिषिञ्चतु पाङ्क्तेन छन्दसा । इत्य् उपरिष्टात् ।
18.17.362.m: Having recited these same three [verses, he sprinkles him] from above with: 'May Bṛhaspati sprinkle you from above with the paṅkti meter!'

18.17.362.s: athāsyora ūrdhvam unmṛjyate | aruṇaṃ tvā vṛkam ugraṃ svajaṃkaram iti |
18.17.362.d: अथास्योर ऊर्ध्वम् उन्मृज्यते । अरुणं त्वा वृकम् उग्रं स्वजंकरम् इति ।
18.17.362.m: Then his chest is wiped upwards with: 'You, the reddish wolf, mighty, making your own kindred...'

18.17.362.s: athāsya bāhū anumārṣṭi pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase nas | iti |
18.17.362.d: अथास्य बाहू अनुमार्ष्टि प्र बाहवा सिसृतं जीवसे नस् । इति ।
18.17.362.m: Then he wipes along his two arms with: 'Stretch forth your arms for our life!'

18.17.362.s: athaināv upāvaharati | indrasya te vīryakṛto bāhū upāvaharāmi | iti |
18.17.362.d: अथैनाव् उपावहरति । इन्द्रस्य ते वीर्यकृतो बाहू उपावहरामि । इति ।
18.17.362.m: Then he brings them down with: 'I bring down the two arms of you who perform Indra's heroic deed.'

18.17.362.s: atrāsmai dhanuḥ prayacchati yadi purastād aprattaṃ bhavati
18.17.362.d: अत्रास्मै धनुः प्रयच्छति यदि पुरस्ताद् अप्रत्तं भवति
18.17.362.m: At this point he hands him the bow, if it has not been handed over before.

18.17.362.s: samunmṛṣṭe samutkrośantīti samānam ā mukhasya vimārjanāt |
18.17.362.d: समुन्मृष्टे समुत्क्रोशन्तीति समानम् आ मुखस्य विमार्जनात् ।
18.17.362.m: When he is wiped, they shout together—this is the same up to the wiping of the face.

18.17.363.s: uttarata etad dhūpāyitam̐ śataṃ tiṣṭhati rathaś ca tad abhipraiti | abhiprehi vīrayasva | ugraś cettā sapatnahā | ātiṣṭha vṛtrahantamas tubhyaṃ devā adhibravan | iti |
18.17.363.d: उत्तरत एतद् धूपायितँ शतं तिष्ठति रथश् च तद् अभिप्रैति । अभिप्रेहि वीरयस्व । उग्रश् चेत्ता सपत्नहा । आतिष्ठ वृत्रहन्तमस् तुभ्यं देवा अधिब्रवन् । इति ।
18.17.363.m: To the north, this [group of] one hundred steeds and the chariot stand fuming with smoke. He approaches it with: 'Advance, display heroism, / a fierce avenger, slayer of rivals; / mount [the chariot], best slayer of Vṛtra; / the gods have spoken in your favor!'

18.17.363.s: atha rathasya pakṣasī saṃmṛśati | aṅkau nyaṅkāv abhito rathaṃ yau dhvāntaṃ vātāgram anu saṃcarantau | dūrehetir indriyāvān patatrī te no 'gnayaḥ paprayaḥ pārayantu | iti |
18.17.363.d: अथ रथस्य पक्षसी संमृशति । अङ्कौ न्यङ्काव् अभितो रथं यौ ध्वान्तं वाताग्रम् अनु संचरन्तौ । दूरेहेतिर् इन्द्रियावान् पतत्री ते नो ऽग्नयः पप्रयः पारयन्तु । इति ।
18.17.363.m: Then he touches both flanks of the chariot with: 'The two curved hooks on both sides of the chariot, / moving along darkness and the tip of the wind, / far-darting, powerful, winged— / may those fires, well filling, carry us across!'

18.17.363.s: atha ratham upatiṣṭhate namas ta ṛṣe gada | iti |
18.17.363.d: अथ रथम् उपतिष्ठते नमस् त ऋषे गद । इति ।
18.17.363.m: Then he attends upon the chariot with: 'Homage to you, O seer, speaker!'

18.17.363.s: atha raśmīn ādatte | evā brahman taved astu tiṣṭhā rathe adhi yad vajrahastaḥ | ā raśmīnd eva yuvase svaśvas | iti
18.17.363.d: अथ रश्मीन् आदत्ते । एवा ब्रह्मन् तवेद् अस्तु तिष्ठा रथे अधि यद् वज्रहस्तः । आ रश्मीन्द् एव युवसे स्वश्वस् । इति
18.17.363.m: Then he takes the reins with: 'So be it yours, O brāhmaṇa! Mount upon the chariot, you who hold the vajra in your hand! You gather the reins, possessing good horses.'

18.17.363.s: ratham ātiṣṭhati | ātiṣṭha vṛtrahan ratham ātiṣṭhantaṃ pari | anu tvendro madatu | indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhan | ity ātas |
18.17.363.d: रथम् आतिष्ठति । आतिष्ठ वृत्रहन् रथम् आतिष्ठन्तं परि । अनु त्वेन्द्रो मदतु । इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन् । इत्य् आतस् ।
18.17.363.m: He mounts the chariot with: 'Mount the chariot, O slayer of Vṛtra... around him mounting...', 'May Indra gladden you...', 'All [chants] have magnified Indra'—up to this point.

18.17.363.s: atra dhanur adhijyaṃ kurute pari mā senyā ghoṣās tan me 'numatir anumanyatām iti dvābhyām
18.17.363.d: अत्र धनुर् अधिज्यं कुरुते परि मा सेन्या घोषास् तन् मे ऽनुमतिर् अनुमन्यताम् इति द्वाभ्याम्
18.17.363.m: At this point he strings the bow with the two [verses]: 'Around me the noises of the army...', 'May Anumati approve that for me.'

18.17.363.s: athaitac chataṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pariyāya puraskṛtyāyāti |
18.17.363.d: अथैतच् छतं त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं परियाय पुरस्कृत्यायाति ।
18.17.363.m: Then, having driven around this one hundred [steeds] three times clockwise, placing it in front, he approaches.
At this point, from the place of descent, he sets down a chair for him.

18.17.364.s: tāṃ tathā pratyavarohati yathā rājasūye tathā ||
18.17.364.d: तां तथा प्रत्यवरोहति यथा राजसूये तथा ॥
18.17.364.m: He steps down onto it in the same manner as in the Rājasūya.

18.18.364.s: yāvad evātrādhvaryuś ceṣṭati tāvad eṣa pratiprasthātā vāruṇena śṛtenoparamati
18.18.364.d: यावद् एवात्राध्वर्युश् चेष्टति तावद् एष प्रतिप्रस्थाता वारुणेन शृतेनोपरमति
18.18.364.m: As long as the adhvaryu priest is busy here, so long this pratiprasthātṛ priest pauses with the cooked [offering] to Varuṇa.
There are two [verses] to Varuṇa for the [offering] to Varuṇa, [and] two containing the word sviṣṭa for the Sviṣṭakṛt.

18.18.364.s: atrāsmā etac chataṃ dadāti | athainaṃ vimitenābhivighnanti
18.18.364.d: अत्रास्मा एतच् छतं ददाति । अथैनं विमितेनाभिविघ्नन्ति
18.18.364.m: At this point he gives him this one hundred [steeds]. Then they enclose him with an enclosure.

18.18.364.s: tasyottarārdhe dundubhim āsañjayati tam astaṃyāty āditya āghnanti | athainam̐ sam̐śāsti yajamāna vācaṃ yaccha rāṣṭre ca jāgṛhi | iti
18.18.364.d: तस्योत्तरार्धे दुन्दुभिम् आसञ्जयति तम् अस्तंयात्य् आदित्य आघ्नन्ति । अथैनँ सँशास्ति यजमान वाचं यच्छ राष्ट्रे च जागृहि । इति
18.18.364.m: In its northern half he suspends a drum. When the sun is setting, they beat it. Then he instructs him: 'Sacrificer, keep silence, and watch over the realm!'
From then on he keeps silence.

18.18.364.s: sa yat kiṃca vyāharati dadāmi | ity eva vyāharati |
18.18.364.d: स यत् किंच व्याहरति ददामि । इत्य् एव व्याहरति ।
18.18.364.m: Whatever he utters, he utters only: 'I give.'

18.18.364.s: upasaṃgacchanta enam ete rājagṛhāḥ sūtagrāmaṇyaḥ kṣatrasaṃgrahītāraḥ kāruviśā iti
18.18.364.d: उपसंगच्छन्त एनम् एते राजगृहाः सूतग्रामण्यः क्षत्रसंग्रहीतारः कारुविशा इति
18.18.364.m: These royal attendants assemble around him: charioteers and village heads, commanders and charioteers, artisans and commoners.
To them he gives a four-year-old barren cow.

18.18.364.s: tāṃ te pacamānā ramayanto jāgarayanta āsate | athādhvaryur apararātra ādrutya catuṣṭayīnām apāṃ prareke mantham upamathyāvaghrāya vānavaghrāya vā prayacchati
18.18.364.d: तां ते पचमाना रमयन्तो जागरयन्त आसते । अथाध्वर्युर् अपररात्र आद्रुत्य चतुष्टयीनाम् अपां प्ररेके मन्थम् उपमथ्यावघ्राय वानवघ्राय वा प्रयच्छति
18.18.364.m: Cooking it, entertaining [him] and keeping him awake, they sit. Then, in the latter part of the night, having run up, the adhvaryu priest churns a mash in a surplus of four kinds of waters, and hands it to him, either having smelled it or without smelling it.

18.18.364.s: tam̐ sa bhakṣayati tūṣṇīm athainaṃ navanītenābhyanakti | enā vyāghraṃ pariṣasvajānās | iti |
18.18.364.d: तँ स भक्षयति तूष्णीम् अथैनं नवनीतेनाभ्यनक्ति । एना व्याघ्रं परिषस्वजानास् । इति ।
18.18.364.m: He consumes it silently. Then he anoints him with fresh butter with: 'Embracing the tiger with these...'

18.18.364.s: athādityam udyantam upatiṣṭhate | ud asāv etu sūryas | ud idaṃ māmakaṃ vacaḥ | ud ihi deva sūrya saha vagnunā mama | ahaṃ vāco vivācanam | mayi vāg astu dharṇasis | iti
18.18.364.d: अथादित्यम् उद्यन्तम् उपतिष्ठते । उद् असाव् एतु सूर्यस् । उद् इदं मामकं वचः । उद् इहि देव सूर्य सह वग्नुना मम । अहं वाचो विवाचनम् । मयि वाग् अस्तु धर्णसिस् । इति
18.18.364.m: Then he attends upon the rising sun with: 'May that sun rise up, / may this word of mine rise up! / Rise up, divine sun, / together with my voice! / I am the arbiter of speech, / may speech abide in me as supporter!'

18.18.365.s: rājagṛhān vipravrajato 'numantrayate yantu nadayo varṣantu parjanyāḥ supippalā oṣadhayo bhavantu | annavatām odanavatām āmikṣavatām eṣām̐ rājā bhūyāsam iti ||
18.18.365.d: राजगृहान् विप्रव्रजतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते यन्तु नदयो वर्षन्तु पर्जन्याः सुपिप्पला ओषधयो भवन्तु । अन्नवताम् ओदनवताम् आमिक्षवताम् एषाँ राजा भूयासम् इति ॥
18.18.365.m: He recites over the royal attendants departing in various directions: 'May the rivers flow, may the rain-clouds shower, / may the plants bear good fruit! / May I be the king of these who possess food, boiled rice, and curd!'

18.19.365.s: atraitad dvādaśāhaṃ vrataṃ carati sa yadi prāṅ vodaṅ voccarati cārmapakṣībhyāṃ kṣaumaṃ vasānas |
18.19.365.d: अत्रैतद् द्वादशाहं व्रतं चरति स यदि प्राङ् वोदङ् वोच्चरति चार्मपक्षीभ्यां क्षौमं वसानस् ।
18.19.365.m: At this point he observes this twelve-day observance: If he steps out towards the east or towards the north, wearing linen [shoes] with leather flaps;

18.19.365.s: atha yadi dakṣiṇataḥ paścād vā vaiyāghrībhyāṃ vṛṣṇivāsasaṃ vasānas |
18.19.365.d: अथ यदि दक्षिणतः पश्चाद् वा वैयाघ्रीभ्यां वृष्णिवाससं वसानस् ।
18.19.365.m: and if towards the south or towards the west, wearing shoes made of tiger-skin and a garment made of ram's wool.

18.19.365.s: atha dvādaśasu vyuṣṭāsu dve sruvāhutī juhoti ye keśinas | narte | iti dvābhyām
18.19.365.d: अथ द्वादशसु व्युष्टासु द्वे स्रुवाहुती जुहोति ये केशिनस् । नर्ते । इति द्वाभ्याम्
18.19.365.m: Then, when twelve [dawns] have shone forth, he offers two ladle libations with the two [mantras]: "Those who have hair..." [and] "Except..."

18.19.365.s: atha proṣṭham ārohati | āroha proṣṭhaṃ viṣahasva śatrūn iti |
18.19.365.d: अथ प्रोष्ठम् आरोहति । आरोह प्रोष्ठं विषहस्व शत्रून् इति ।
18.19.365.m: Then he mounts the bench with: "Mount the bench, conquer the enemies!"

18.19.365.s: athāsya śiraḥ pramandayati yat sīmantaṃ kaṅkatas te lilekha | iti |
18.19.365.d: अथास्य शिरः प्रमन्दयति यत् सीमन्तं कङ्कतस् ते लिलेख । इति ।
18.19.365.m: Then he combs his head with: "The parting of the hair which the comb scratched for you..."

18.19.365.s: athāsya keśān vapati yenāvapat savitā kṣureṇa | iti
18.19.365.d: अथास्य केशान् वपति येनावपत् सविता क्षुरेण । इति
18.19.365.m: Then he shaves his hair with: "With which razor Savitar shaved..."

18.19.365.s: pravapato 'numantrayate mā te keśān anugād varca etat | iti |
18.19.365.d: प्रवपतो ऽनुमन्त्रयते मा ते केशान् अनुगाद् वर्च एतत् । इति ।
18.19.365.m: As he shaves, he recites over him: "Let this splendor not depart after your hair!"

18.19.365.s: athainān samuccitya darbhastabme nidadhāti tebhyo nidhānaṃ bahudhā vyaicchan | iti |
18.19.365.d: अथैनान् समुच्चित्य दर्भस्तब्मे निदधाति तेभ्यो निधानं बहुधा व्यैच्छन् । इति ।
18.19.365.m: Then, having gathered it, he places it in a clump of darbha grass with: "For them they sought a repository in many places..."

18.19.365.s: athainam uṣṇodakenāplāvayati balaṃ te bāhuvoḥ savitā dadhātu | iti
18.19.365.d: अथैनम् उष्णोदकेनाप्लावयति बलं ते बाहुवोः सविता दधातु । इति
18.19.365.m: Then he bathes him with warm water with: "May Savitar place strength in your two arms!"

18.19.365.s: tena haitena mṛtyur īje prajānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyaṃ parīyām iti
18.19.365.d: तेन हैतेन मृत्युर् ईजे प्रजानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यं परीयाम् इति
18.19.365.m: "With this very [sacrifice] Death sacrificed, thinking: 'May I attain sovereignty, overlordship, and kingship over creatures.'"

18.19.365.s: tato vai sa prajānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyaṃ paryait |
18.19.365.d: ततो वै स प्रजानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यं पर्यैत् ।
18.19.365.m: "Then indeed he attained sovereignty, overlordship, and kingship over creatures."

18.19.365.s: yaḥ kāmayeta samānānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam̐ rājyaṃ parīyām iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta
18.19.365.d: यः कामयेत समानानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यँ राज्यं परीयाम् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत
18.19.365.m: One who desires: 'May I attain sovereignty, overlordship, and kingship over my equals', should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite.
He attains sovereignty, overlordship, and kingship over his equals.

18.19.365.s: atha haitena surathaḥ śaivya īja ātiṣṭhyaṃ paramatām iyām iti
18.19.365.d: अथ हैतेन सुरथः शैव्य ईज आतिष्ठ्यं परमताम् इयाम् इति
18.19.365.m: "Then indeed Suratha Śaivya sacrificed with this [rite], thinking: 'May I attain pre-eminence and the highest state.'"

18.19.366.s: tato vai sa ātiṣṭhyaṃ paramatām ait |
18.19.366.d: ततो वै स आतिष्ठ्यं परमताम् ऐत् ।
18.19.366.m: "Then indeed he attained pre-eminence and the highest state."

18.19.366.s: yaḥ kāmayetātiṣṭhyaṃ paramatām iyām iti sa etena yajñakratunā yajeta |
18.19.366.d: यः कामयेतातिष्ठ्यं परमताम् इयाम् इति स एतेन यज्ञक्रतुना यजेत ।
18.19.366.m: One who desires: 'May I attain pre-eminence and the highest state', should sacrifice with this sacrificial rite.
He indeed attains pre-eminence and the highest state.

18.20.366.s: sadyaskriyā yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa yūpyaṃ ca vṛkṣaṃ chedayati lāṅgalyaṃ ca |
18.20.366.d: सद्यस्क्रिया यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स यूप्यं च वृक्षं छेदयति लाङ्गल्यं च ।
18.20.366.m: When he is about to sacrifice with the sadyaskrī ritual, he causes a tree suitable for the sacrificial post to be cut down, and also one suitable for a plow.

18.20.366.s: īṣāṃ yūpyasya kārayati lāṅgalaṃ lāṅgalyasya tau sam̐hatya bhuñjate vā ni vā dadhati |
18.20.366.d: ईषां यूप्यस्य कारयति लाङ्गलं लाङ्गल्यस्य तौ सँहत्य भुञ्जते वा नि वा दधति ।
18.20.366.m: He causes the pole of the plow to be made from the post-timber, and the plow from the plow-timber; having joined the two, they either use them or set them aside.

18.20.366.s: athāsyaitat purastād eva juṣṭe devayajane vedisaṃmitaṃ vimitaṃ kāritaṃ bhavati
18.20.366.d: अथास्यैतत् पुरस्ताद् एव जुष्टे देवयजने वेदिसंमितं विमितं कारितं भवति
18.20.366.m: Then previously, on an approved sacrificial site, a shed measured to the size of the altar has been caused to be erected for him.
He has that [area] plowed around with this plow.
Having had late-sown [crops] sown into it, he has it fenced around.

18.20.366.s: athāsyaite rathā upakḷptā bhavanti caturyuk praṣṭivāhī dviyoga sthūrir iti
18.20.366.d: अथास्यैते रथा उपकॢप्ता भवन्ति चतुर्युक् प्रष्टिवाही द्वियोग स्थूरिर् इति
18.20.366.m: Then these chariots are prepared for him: a four-horse chariot, a three-horse chariot, a two-horse chariot, and a one-horse chariot.
On them, at the proper time, they suspend churn-vessels filled with curd.

18.20.366.s: sa grīṣmasya jaghanyāhaḥsu prajahiteṣu yaveṣv ṛtvijaḥ padenāhvāpayati | iṣṭyā vā mā yājayiṣyatha bhaktaṃ vā vaḥ kārayiṣyāmi | iti
18.20.366.d: स ग्रीष्मस्य जघन्याहःसु प्रजहितेषु यवेष्व् ऋत्विजः पदेनाह्वापयति । इष्ट्या वा मा याजयिष्यथ भक्तं वा वः कारयिष्यामि । इति
18.20.366.m: During the last days of summer, when the barley has been abandoned, he causes the officiating priests to be summoned by [sending someone to] their footprints, saying: "Will you perform a sacrifice for me, or shall I have food prepared for you?"
When they have assembled, at the proper time he offers the morning agnihotra.

18.20.366.s: upasaṃgacchanta enam eta ṛtvijas | athainān āha sadyaskriyā mā yājayata | iti
18.20.366.d: उपसंगच्छन्त एनम् एत ऋत्विजस् । अथैनान् आह सद्यस्क्रिया मा याजयत । इति
18.20.366.m: These officiating priests approach him; then he says to them: "Perform the sadyaskrī sacrifice for me!"

18.20.366.s: tam | tathā | itītare pratyāhus tasmai tadānīm eva sadyaskāryām̐ śālāṃ kurvanti
18.20.366.d: तम् । तथा । इतीतरे प्रत्याहुस् तस्मै तदानीम् एव सद्यस्कार्याँ शालां कुर्वन्ति
18.20.366.m: The others reply to him: "So be it." For him they immediately construct a shed to be made on the same day.

18.20.367.s: taṃ tadānīm eva tīrthādānīya pavayitvā dīkṣaṇīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati
18.20.367.d: तं तदानीम् एव तीर्थादानीय पवयित्वा दीक्षणीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति
18.20.367.m: Having brought him right then from the sacred ford and having purified him, he pours out the oblation for the initiatory offering.

18.20.367.s: tasyām̐ sam̐sthitāyāṃ muṣṭī caiva na karoti vācaṃ ca na yacchati
18.20.367.d: तस्याँ सँस्थितायां मुष्टी चैव न करोति वाचं च न यच्छति
18.20.367.m: When it is concluded, he neither clenches his fists nor does he restrain his speech.

18.20.367.s: nidadhaty asmā etad dhavir ucchiṣṭaṃ vratabhājanam
18.20.367.d: निदधत्य् अस्मा एतद् धविर् उच्छिष्टं व्रतभाजनम्
18.20.367.m: They deposit this leftover oblation for him as his fast-food vessel.
Then he pours out the oblation for the introductory offering.

18.20.367.s: haviṣkṛtā vācaṃ visṛjate | atrāsmā etad dhavir ucchiṣṭaṃ prayacchanti vratabhājanam etat
18.20.367.d: हविष्कृता वाचं विसृजते । अत्रास्मा एतद् धविर् उच्छिष्टं प्रयच्छन्ति व्रतभाजनम् एतत्
18.20.367.m: He releases his speech with the call to the preparer of the oblation; then they hand over to him this leftover oblation, which is this fast-food vessel.

18.20.367.s: prasūtā evaite rathā ājiṃ dhāvanti yojanaṃ prāk caturyuk traipadaṃ dakṣiṇā praṣṭivāhī
18.20.367.d: प्रसूता एवैते रथा आजिं धावन्ति योजनं प्राक् चतुर्युक् त्रैपदं दक्षिणा प्रष्टिवाही
18.20.367.m: Once urged on, these chariots run a race: the four-horse chariot one yojana to the east; the three-horse chariot three quarters of a yojana to the south;
the two-horse chariot a gavyūti to the west;

18.20.367.s: krośam udak sthūrir iti te yenayena saṃgacchante tasmā āvedayante yajate 'yam asāv āmuṣyāyaṇo 'muṣya putro 'muṣya pautro 'muṣya naptā sadyaskriyeti |
18.20.367.d: क्रोशम् उदक् स्थूरिर् इति ते येनयेन संगच्छन्ते तस्मा आवेदयन्ते यजते ऽयम् असाव् आमुष्यायणो ऽमुष्य पुत्रो ऽमुष्य पौत्रो ऽमुष्य नप्ता सद्यस्क्रियेति ।
18.20.367.m: the one-horse chariot a krośa to the north. Whomsoever they meet, to him they announce: "This one, of such a lineage, son of so-and-so, grandson of so-and-so, great-grandson of so-and-so, is sacrificing with the sadyaskrī ritual!"

18.20.367.s: āyanti rathās | āgateṣu ratheṣu yad vināleṣu navanītam utsīdati tad vilāpyotpūyājyakumbhe pratyasyati sadyastāyās | iti ||
18.20.367.d: आयन्ति रथास् । आगतेषु रथेषु यद् विनालेषु नवनीतम् उत्सीदति तद् विलाप्योत्पूयाज्यकुम्भे प्रत्यस्यति सद्यस्तायास् । इति ॥
18.20.367.m: The chariots return; when the chariots have returned, whatever butter rises up in the churn-vessels, having melted it and strained it, he casts it into the ghee-pot with: "For the state of happening on the same day..."

18.21.368.s: atha prāyaṇīyena carati prāyaṇīyena caritvā padena carati
18.21.368.d: अथ प्रायणीयेन चरति प्रायणीयेन चरित्वा पदेन चरति
18.21.368.m: Then he proceeds with the introductory offering; having proceeded with the introductory offering, he proceeds with the footprint [of the soma cow].

18.21.368.s: padena caritvā trivatsena sāṇḍena vatsatareṇa rājānaṃ krītvohyātithyaṃ nirvapati |
18.21.368.d: पदेन चरित्वा त्रिवत्सेन साण्डेन वत्सतरेण राजानं क्रीत्वोह्यातिथ्यं निर्वपति ।
18.21.368.m: Having proceeded with the footprint, having purchased King Soma with a three-year-old uncastrated bull calf, and having brought him, he pours out the guest-offering.
Having performed the guest-offering, the upasad offerings occur as a single group.

18.21.368.s: madhyamayopasadā pracaryottaravedyai kāle khalevālīṃ māpayati | athānaḍuhaḥ saṃyujya yavān prakṛtya mṛṇanti
18.21.368.d: मध्यमयोपसदा प्रचर्योत्तरवेद्यै काले खलेवालीं मापयति । अथानडुहः संयुज्य यवान् प्रकृत्य मृणन्ति
18.21.368.m: Having performed the middle upasad, at the time of the high altar, he measures out the post of the threshing floor; then, having yoked the oxen, having cut the barley, they thresh it.
The high altar consists merely of barley-chaff.

18.21.368.s: atha madhye 'naḍuhaḥ saṃyujya prāco yavān pragṛhṇanto yanti
18.21.368.d: अथ मध्ये ऽनडुहः संयुज्य प्राचो यवान् प्रगृह्णन्तो यन्ति
18.21.368.m: Then, having yoked the oxen in the middle, they go eastward holding the barley.

18.21.368.s: yavabarhir evaiṣā mahāvedir bhavati | athāhavanīyaṃ praṇayati | āhavanīyaṃ praṇīya sadohavirdhāne saṃminoti
18.21.368.d: यवबर्हिर् एवैषा महावेदिर् भवति । अथाहवनीयं प्रणयति । आहवनीयं प्रणीय सदोहविर्धाने संमिनोति
18.21.368.m:
This great altar consists simply of barley straw. Then he leads forward the āhavanīya fire; having led forward the āhavanīya fire, he erects the sadas shed and the havirdhāna shed.

Having erected the sadas shed and the havirdhāna shed, he leads forward the fire and the soma.

18.21.368.s: agnīṣomau praṇīya vasatīvarīr gṛhṇāti tās tadānīm eva parihṛtya prātaranuvākam upākaroti
18.21.368.d: अग्नीषोमौ प्रणीय वसतीवरीर् गृह्णाति तास् तदानीम् एव परिहृत्य प्रातरनुवाकम् उपाकरोति
18.21.368.m: Having led forward the fire and the soma, he takes the vasatīvarī waters; having carried them around right then, he begins the morning recitation.
When the morning recitation has been concluded, he goes toward the waters.

18.21.368.s: adbhir udaiti | agniṣṭomaṃ kratum upaiti prasiddho 'bhiṣavaḥ
18.21.368.d: अद्भिर् उदैति । अग्निष्टोमं क्रतुम् उपैति प्रसिद्धो ऽभिषवः
18.21.368.m: He comes up with the waters; he undertakes the agniṣṭoma sacrifice; the pressing [of soma] is well known.

18.21.368.s: prasiddhaṃ grahā gṛhyante samānaṃ karmāśvinād grāhāt | āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā tisro raśanā ādāya lāṅgalyām abhyaiti
18.21.368.d: प्रसिद्धं ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते समानं कर्माश्विनाद् ग्राहात् । आश्विनं ग्रहं गृहीत्वा तिस्रो रशना आदाय लाङ्गल्याम् अभ्यैति
18.21.368.m: The soma-cups are drawn according to the established rule; the rite is the same up to the cup for the Aśvins; having drawn the cup for the Aśvins, taking three cords, he approaches the plow-timber [serving as the post].
On its lower part, there is a place for the post-ring as it were.

18.21.368.s: śakalāntāṃ lāṅgalyām utsṛjyāthaitān paśūn upākaroty agnīṣomīyam āgneyam anūbandhyam iti
18.21.368.d: शकलान्तां लाङ्गल्याम् उत्सृज्याथैतान् पशून् उपाकरोत्य् अग्नीषोमीयम् आग्नेयम् अनूबन्ध्यम् इति
18.21.368.m: Having left the plow-timber with its chip at the end, he then assigns these animals: the one for Agni-Soma, the one for Agni, and the anūbandhyā cow.

18.21.369.m: They run up successively with their omenta.

18.22.369.s: agnīṣomīyasyādhvaryur vapayā prathamayā prapadyate | anūcī itare āharanti
18.22.369.d: अग्नीषोमीयस्याध्वर्युर् वपया प्रथमया प्रपद्यते । अनूची इतरे आहरन्ति
18.22.369.m: The adhvaryu priest enters first with the omentum of the victim for Agni-Soma; the others bring [the others] in succession.

18.22.369.s: parihitāsu stokīyāsu śṛtāsu vapāsv agnīṣomīyasya vapayā pracarati
18.22.369.d: परिहितासु स्तोकीयासु शृतासु वपास्व् अग्नीषोमीयस्य वपया प्रचरति
18.22.369.m: When the drops-offerings have been concluded and the omenta are cooked, he proceeds with the omentum of the victim for Agni-Soma.

18.22.369.s: parītare śāyayanti prātaḥsavanīyānām agnīṣomīyasya paśupuroḍāśo mukhyo bhavati
18.22.369.d: परीतरे शाययन्ति प्रातःसवनीयानाम् अग्नीषोमीयस्य पशुपुरोडाशो मुख्यो भवति
18.22.369.m: The others lay [the other omenta] down around. Among the morning-pressing offerings, the animal cake of the victim for Agni-Soma is primary.
When the midday pavamāna chant has been sung, he proceeds with the [meat of the] victim for Agni-Soma.
Immediately, he proceeds with the omentum of the victim for Agni.

18.22.369.s: sve dhāmann āgneyena carati | anantarhita evānūbandhyasya vapayā carati
18.22.369.d: स्वे धामन्न् आग्नेयेन चरति । अनन्तर्हित एवानूबन्ध्यस्य वपया चरति
18.22.369.m: At its proper place, he proceeds with the [meat of the] victim for Agni; immediately, he proceeds with the omentum of the anūbandhyā cow.
Among the third-pressing offerings, the animal cake of the anūbandhyā cow is primary.
Before [the stars] have appeared together, he proceeds with the [meat of the] anūbandhyā cow; the sadyaskrī ritual is completed.

18.22.369.s: tasya yad asadyaskriyate vyṛddham evāsya tat punar yajña evāsya tat | athādityāś ca ha vā aṅgirasaś ca suvarge loke paspṛdhire
18.22.369.d: तस्य यद् असद्यस्क्रियते व्यृद्धम् एवास्य तत् पुनर् यज्ञ एवास्य तत् । अथादित्याश् च ह वा अङ्गिरसश् च सुवर्गे लोके पस्पृधिरे
18.22.369.m: Whatever of it is not performed on the same day, that of his becomes a failure, that becomes for him a sacrifice to be repeated. "Now the Ādityas and the Aṅgirases vied with each other for the heavenly world."

18.22.369.s: te 'ṅgirasa ādityān abhiprajagmur agninā dūtena śvaḥsutyā na iti |
18.22.369.d: ते ऽङ्गिरस आदित्यान् अभिप्रजग्मुर् अग्निना दूतेन श्वःसुत्या न इति ।
18.22.369.m: "Those Aṅgirases approached the Ādityas with Agni as messenger, [saying]: 'Tomorrow is our soma pressing!'"

18.23.370.s: ādityāḥ procus teṣāṃ nas tvam̐ hoteti te 'mum ādityam aśvam̐ śvetaṃ bhūtaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ninyire hiraṇyābhibhūtaraśanam |
18.23.370.d: आदित्याः प्रोचुस् तेषां नस् त्वँ होतेति ते ऽमुम् आदित्यम् अश्वँ श्वेतं भूतं दक्षिणां निन्यिरे हिरण्याभिभूतरशनम् ।
18.23.370.m: 'The Ādityas said: "Be our hotṛ priest!" They took that sun, which had become a white horse with a golden halter, as the sacrificial gift.'
Therefore, for the Sadyaskrī, the sacrificial gift is a white horse with a golden halter.
In that it is a white horse, that is the form of the sun.

18.23.370.s: atha yad dhiraṇyābhibhūtaraśano raśmīnāṃ tat tasya trivṛtaḥ sataś caturvim̐śau mādhyaṃdinārbhavau bhavatas |
18.23.370.d: अथ यद् धिरण्याभिभूतरशनो रश्मीनां तत् तस्य त्रिवृतः सतश् चतुर्विँशौ माध्यंदिनार्भवौ भवतस् ।
18.23.370.m: And in that it has a golden halter, that is [the form] of the rays. Of this [rite], being nine-versed, the midday and the Arbhave [stotras] are twenty-four-versed.
The pṛṣṭha stotra of the hotṛ priest is forty-four-versed.

18.23.370.s: caturvim̐śam agniṣṭomasāma trivṛd anyat sarvam | śvetam aśvaṃ dadāti |
18.23.370.d: चतुर्विँशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम त्रिवृद् अन्यत् सर्वम् । श्वेतम् अश्वं ददाति ।
18.23.370.m: The agniṣṭoma saman is twenty-four-versed; all the rest is nine-versed. He gives a white horse.

18.23.370.s: anukriyā yakṣyamāṇo vrīhiṣu dīkṣate sa dvyahena saṃtiṣṭhata aupavasathyād ekam ahaḥ sutyam ekam ahas
18.23.370.d: अनुक्रिया यक्ष्यमाणो व्रीहिषु दीक्षते स द्व्यहेन संतिष्ठत औपवसथ्याद् एकम् अहः सुत्यम् एकम् अहस्
18.23.370.m: One intending to sacrifice with the Anukrī is consecrated during [the growth of] rice. It is concluded in two days: one day for the preparatory rites, one day for the soma extraction.

18.23.370.s: tasya trivṛta eva sataś catvārim̐śau mādhyaṃdinārbhavau bhavatas |
18.23.370.d: तस्य त्रिवृत एव सतश् चत्वारिँशौ माध्यंदिनार्भवौ भवतस् ।
18.23.370.m: Of this [rite], being nine-versed, the midday and the Arbhave [stotras] are forty-versed.
The pṛṣṭha stotra of the hotṛ priest is forty-four-versed.

18.23.370.s: catuścatvārim̐śam agniṣṭomasāma trivṛd evānyat sarvam | śvetāṃ vaḍabāṃ dadāti
18.23.370.d: चतुश्चत्वारिँशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम त्रिवृद् एवान्यत् सर्वम् । श्वेतां वडबां ददाति
18.23.370.m: The agniṣṭoma saman is forty-four-versed; all the rest is nine-versed. He gives a white mare.

18.23.370.s: parikriyā yakṣyamāṇo māṣeṣu dīkṣate sa tryaheṇa saṃtiṣṭhata ā kryād ekam ahar aupavasathyād ekam ahaḥ sutyam ekam ahas
18.23.370.d: परिक्रिया यक्ष्यमाणो माषेषु दीक्षते स त्र्यहेण संतिष्ठत आ क्र्याद् एकम् अहर् औपवसथ्याद् एकम् अहः सुत्यम् एकम् अहस्
18.23.370.m: One intending to sacrifice with the Parikrī is consecrated during [the growth of] beans. It is concluded in three days: one day up to the soma-purchase, one day for the preparatory rites, one day for the soma extraction.

18.23.370.s: tasya trivṛta eva sato 'ṣṭācatvārim̐śau mādhyaṃdinārbhavau bhavatas |
18.23.370.d: तस्य त्रिवृत एव सतो ऽष्टाचत्वारिँशौ माध्यंदिनार्भवौ भवतस् ।
18.23.370.m: Of this [rite], being nine-versed, the midday and the Arbhave [stotras] are forty-eight-versed.
The pṛṣṭha stotra of the hotṛ priest is forty-eight-versed; the agniṣṭoma saman is forty-eight-versed.

18.23.371.s: trivṛd evānyat sarvam | yathāśraddhaṃ dadāti | atikriyā yakṣyamāṇas tileṣu dīkṣate
18.23.371.d: त्रिवृद् एवान्यत् सर्वम् । यथाश्रद्धं ददाति । अतिक्रिया यक्ष्यमाणस् तिलेषु दीक्षते
18.23.371.m: All the rest is nine-versed. He gives according to his faith. One intending to sacrifice with the Atikrī is consecrated during [the growth of] sesame.

18.23.371.s: sa caturaheṇa saṃtiṣṭhata ā krayād ekam ahar ottaraveder ekam ahar aupavasathyād ekam ahaḥ sutyam ekam ahar |
18.23.371.d: स चतुरहेण संतिष्ठत आ क्रयाद् एकम् अहर् ओत्तरवेदेर् एकम् अहर् औपवसथ्याद् एकम् अहः सुत्यम् एकम् अहर् ।
18.23.371.m: It is concluded in four days: one day up to the soma-purchase, one day up to the high altar, one day for the preparatory rites, one day for the soma extraction.

18.24.371.s: vrātyastomena yakṣyamāṇo bhavati te rājani vā brāhmaṇe vā pratigraham icchante māsāya vartave vā
18.24.371.d: व्रात्यस्तोमेन यक्ष्यमाणो भवति ते राजनि वा ब्राह्मणे वा प्रतिग्रहम् इच्छन्ते मासाय वर्तवे वा
18.24.371.m: One is going to sacrifice with the Vrātyastoma. They seek an acceptance of gifts from a king or a brāhmaṇa, or for dwelling for a month.

18.24.371.s: te yam abhisaṃjānate tam̐ sthapatiṃ kurvanti
18.24.371.d: ते यम् अभिसंजानते तँ स्थपतिं कुर्वन्ति
18.24.371.m: Whomever they agree upon, him they make their leader.

18.24.371.s: sa eṣāṃ vratāni carati so 'dhaḥsaṃveśyamām̐sāśyas tryupāyī bhavati
18.24.371.d: स एषां व्रतानि चरति सो ऽधःसंवेश्यमाँसाश्यस् त्र्युपायी भवति
18.24.371.m: He undertakes their observances. He sleeps on the ground, does not eat meat, and approaches three [times].

18.24.371.s: tad dhi dīkṣitavratam atha yatkṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇatūṣaṃ paridhatte dīkṣitavasanasya tad rūpam atha yat kṛṣṇabalakṣyāvajine dhārayati kṛṣṇājinayos tad rūpam
18.24.371.d: तद् धि दीक्षितव्रतम् अथ यत्कृष्णं वासः कृष्णतूषं परिधत्ते दीक्षितवसनस्य तद् रूपम् अथ यत् कृष्णबलक्ष्यावजिने धारयति कृष्णाजिनयोस् तद् रूपम्
18.24.371.m: For that is the observance of an initiate. Now, that he puts on a black garment with black fringes, that is the form of the initiate's garment. Now, that he wears two black and white skins, that is the form of the two black-antelope skins.

18.24.371.s: atha yat suvarṇarajatau rukmau bibharti parigharmyayos tad rūpam
18.24.371.d: अथ यत् सुवर्णरजतौ रुक्मौ बिभर्ति परिघर्म्ययोस् तद् रूपम्
18.24.371.m: Now, that he wears two gold and silver ornaments, that is the form of the two cauldron-covers.

18.24.371.s: atha yat kṛṣṇam uṣnīṣaṃ dhārayati dīkṣitoṣṇīṣasya tad rūpam
18.24.371.d: अथ यत् कृष्णम् उष्नीषं धारयति दीक्षितोष्णीषस्य तद् रूपम्
18.24.371.m: Now, that he wears a black turban, that is the form of the initiate's turban.

18.24.371.s: atha yac carmamayair bāṇavadbhis tisṛdhanvaṃ dhārayati dīkṣitadaṇḍasya tad rūpam
18.24.371.d: अथ यच् चर्ममयैर् बाणवद्भिस् तिसृधन्वं धारयति दीक्षितदण्डस्य तद् रूपम्
18.24.371.m: Now, that he carries a bow with three leather-bound arrows, that is the form of the initiate's staff.

18.24.371.s: atha yadvrātyavādaṃ vadati dīkṣitavādasya tad rūpam
18.24.371.d: अथ यद्व्रात्यवादं वदति दीक्षितवादस्य तद् रूपम्
18.24.371.m: Now, that he speaks Vrātya speech, that is the form of the consecrated person's speech.

18.24.371.s: atha yat khuryāv upānahau dhārayati ned dīkṣitaḥ sann amedhyam adhitiṣṭhānīti tat
18.24.371.d: अथ यत् खुर्याव् उपानहौ धारयति नेद् दीक्षितः सन्न् अमेध्यम् अधितिष्ठानीति तत्
18.24.371.m: Now, that he wears pointed shoes, that is [with the intention]: 'May I, being consecrated, not tread on what is impure.'

18.24.371.s: tasya ha vā etad rūpasya yajñasya pratodadaṇḍa eva yūpaḥ
18.24.371.d: तस्य ह वा एतद् रूपस्य यज्ञस्य प्रतोददण्ड एव यूपः
18.24.371.m: Of that sacrifice of such form, the driving-stick itself is the sacrificial post.
The binding of the driving-stick is the head-piece; the front of the chariot is the āhavanīya fire.

18.24.372.s: īṣe vedis | yugam uttaravedis | uttarayugam uttaranābhis | dhanurdhī havidhāne
18.24.372.d: ईषे वेदिस् । युगम् उत्तरवेदिस् । उत्तरयुगम् उत्तरनाभिस् । धनुर्धी हविधाने
18.24.372.m: The two shafts are the altar; the yoke is the high altar; the upper yoke is the upper navel; the two quiver-rests are the two havirdhāna sheds.
The two side-boards are the āgnīdhrīya and mārjālīya [hearths]; the pole is the sadas shed.

18.24.372.s: kiṃkarāvatānā dhiṣṇiyā bandhuraṃ patnīśālam | rathopastho gārhapatyas |
18.24.372.d: किंकरावताना धिष्णिया बन्धुरं पत्नीशालम् । रथोपस्थो गार्हपत्यस् ।
18.24.372.m: The lower cross-bars are the side-hearths; the seat-frame is the patnīśālā; the floor of the chariot is the gārhapatya fire.

18.24.372.s: adhiṣṭhānaṃ purāṇagārhapatyas te yam ajaṃ pramāthaṃ pacante sa eṣāṃ paśus |
18.24.372.d: अधिष्ठानं पुराणगार्हपत्यस् ते यम् अजं प्रमाथं पचन्ते स एषां पशुस् ।
18.24.372.m: The driver's stand is the old gārhapatya fire. That goat which they cook as a forcibly seized [offering] is their sacrificial animal.
That cake and cooked dish of rice, they are the pot-offering and the animal cake.

18.24.372.s: yāṃ pariṣkandam̐ hvayati sā puro'nuvākyā yad āharati sā yājyā
18.24.372.d: यां परिष्कन्दँ ह्वयति सा पुरोऽनुवाक्या यद् आहरति सा याज्या
18.24.372.m: Whom he summons as attendant, she is the invitatory verse; what he brings, that is the offering verse.

18.24.372.s: yad aśnanti sa vaṣaṭkāras | yāṃ kumbāṃ vimate sā puro'nuvākyā
18.24.372.d: यद् अश्नन्ति स वषट्कारस् । यां कुम्बां विमते सा पुरोऽनुवाक्या
18.24.372.m: What they eat, that is the vaṣaṭ call. What head-band [she wears] when measured, that is the invitatory verse.

18.24.372.s: yām adhīvākyām̐ sā yājyā yāṃ vigaṇam̐ hvayati sa śastrasya pratigaras |
18.24.372.d: याम् अधीवाक्याँ सा याज्या यां विगणँ ह्वयति स शस्त्रस्य प्रतिगरस् ।
18.24.372.m: What [she wears] as an upper garment, that is the offering verse. Whom he summons shouting in discord, that is the response to the recitation.

18.24.372.s: yad abhikrośanti sa udgīthas te ya evam etaṃ yajñakratuṃ parokṣam upetya pratyakṣaṃ nopeyuḥ ||
18.24.372.d: यद् अभिक्रोशन्ति स उद्गीथस् ते य एवम् एतं यज्ञक्रतुं परोक्षम् उपेत्य प्रत्यक्षं नोपेयुः ॥
18.24.372.m: What they shout out, that is the udgītha. If they, having thus entered upon this ritual of sacrifice indirectly, were not to enter upon it directly,

18.25.372.s: yathā dīkṣitāvakīrṇā vicchinnasomapīthā anāśyānnā evam̐ syus
18.25.372.d: यथा दीक्षितावकीर्णा विच्छिन्नसोमपीथा अनाश्यान्ना एवँ स्युस्
18.25.372.m: they would be like those who have fallen from consecration, whose soma-drinking is cut off, whose food is not to be eaten.

18.25.372.s: tasmād vrātyāvasthitasya vrātyastomenānījānasya nāśyaṃ vicchinnasomapītha iva hy eṣo 'nāśyānnas
18.25.372.d: तस्माद् व्रात्यावस्थितस्य व्रात्यस्तोमेनानीजानस्य नाश्यं विच्छिन्नसोमपीथ इव ह्य् एषो ऽनाश्यान्नस्
18.25.372.m: Therefore, for one who stays in the Vrātya condition and has not sacrificed with the Vrātyastoma, no [food] is to be eaten, for he is like one whose soma-drinking is cut off, whose food is not to be eaten.

18.25.373.s: teṣāṃ ye 'nāhitāgnayas te yathāgṛhaṃ viparetyāgnīn ādhāya trayastrim̐śatātrayastrim̐śatā dakṣiṇābhi sthapatim upasamāyanti
18.25.373.d: तेषां ये ऽनाहिताग्नयस् ते यथागृहं विपरेत्याग्नीन् आधाय त्रयस्त्रिँशतात्रयस्त्रिँशता दक्षिणाभि स्थपतिम् उपसमायन्ति
18.25.373.m: Among them, those who have not established their fires, having returned each to his own house and having set up the fires, approach their leader with thirty-three [cows] each as sacrificial gifts.

18.25.373.s: teṣāṃ brahmabandhurāmāgadho māgadhavākyo brahmabandhurapum̐ścalū pum̐ścalūvākyā jaratkadratho jaratprayogyābhyāṃ yuktas |
18.25.373.d: तेषां ब्रह्मबन्धुरामागधो मागधवाक्यो ब्रह्मबन्धुरपुँश्चलू पुँश्चलूवाक्या जरत्कद्रथो जरत्प्रयोग्याभ्यां युक्तस् ।
18.25.373.m: Of them, [one gives] a degraded brahmin who is not a Magadhan, speaking Magadhan speech, a degraded brahmin who is not a harlot, speaking harlot speech, an old, dilapidated chariot yoked with two old draft-animals.

18.25.373.s: vyṛddhā brahmavandhurapum̐ścalū pum̐ścalūvākyā vyṛddho jaratkadratho jaratprayogyābhyāṃ yuktas |
18.25.373.d: व्यृद्धा ब्रह्मवन्धुरपुँश्चलू पुँश्चलूवाक्या व्यृद्धो जरत्कद्रथो जरत्प्रयोग्याभ्यां युक्तस् ।
18.25.373.m: A degraded brahmin who is not a harlot, speaking harlot speech, is deficient; an old, dilapidated chariot yoked with two old draft-animals is deficient.

18.25.373.s: vyṛddhenaiva vyṛddhaṃ niravadayate tad etad vrātyadhanam̐ samavaśāntaṃ daṇḍopānaham̐ śāmūlājinam |
18.25.373.d: व्यृद्धेनैव व्यृद्धं निरवदयते तद् एतद् व्रात्यधनँ समवशान्तं दण्डोपानहँ शामूलाजिनम् ।
18.25.373.m: By means of the deficient alone he casts off the deficient. That Vrātya property, appeased, [consisting of] the staff and shoes, the woolen garment and the pelt,
standing on the chariot, the subrahmaṇya priest invokes the subrahmaṇyā formula.
At the time of the sacrificial gifts, this indeed is his [gift].

18.25.373.s: ṛtvijo dakṣiṇā vibhajante tasya prātaḥsavanīyān anuvartante saṃjñānyai havīm̐ṣi |
18.25.373.d: ऋत्विजो दक्षिणा विभजन्ते तस्य प्रातःसवनीयान् अनुवर्तन्ते संज्ञान्यै हवीँषि ।
18.25.373.m: The officiating priests divide the sacrificial gifts. Along with his morning pressing follow the oblations for concord.

18.25.373.s: asaṃjñātam iva vā ete caranti ye vrātyaṃ caranti
18.25.373.d: असंज्ञातम् इव वा एते चरन्ति ये व्रात्यं चरन्ति
18.25.373.m: As if discordant indeed they wander who wander as Vrātyas.

18.25.373.s: sam evainān jñāpayanti mādhyaṃdinīyān anuvartata aindrāmāruta ekādaśakapālas |
18.25.373.d: सम् एवैनान् ज्ञापयन्ति माध्यंदिनीयान् अनुवर्तत ऐन्द्रामारुत एकादशकपालस् ।
18.25.373.m: They cause them to agree. Along with the midday pressing follows an eleven-pot-sherd cake for Indra and the Maruts.

18.25.373.s: aindro vai vrātyo māruto grāmas | grāmeṇaivainān samīco dadhāti
18.25.373.d: ऐन्द्रो वै व्रात्यो मारुतो ग्रामस् । ग्रामेणैवैनान् समीचो दधाति
18.25.373.m: The Vrātya belongs to Indra; the troop belongs to the Maruts. By means of the troop he unites them together.
Along with the third pressing follows a cooked dish of rice for the flourishing Ādityas.

18.25.373.s: abhūtā iva vā ete caranti ye vrātyaṃ caranti
18.25.373.d: अभूता इव वा एते चरन्ति ये व्रात्यं चरन्ति
18.25.373.m: As if unprosperous indeed they wander who wander as Vrātyas.

18.25.373.s: bhūtim evainān gamayanti | anūbandhyasya paśupuroḍāśam anuvartata ādityaś carus |
18.25.373.d: भूतिम् एवैनान् गमयन्ति । अनूबन्ध्यस्य पशुपुरोडाशम् अनुवर्तत आदित्यश् चरुस् ।
18.25.373.m: They lead them indeed to prosperity. Along with the animal cake of the anūbandhyā cow follows a cooked dish of rice for Aditi.

18.25.374.s: apratiṣṭhitā iva vā ete caranti ye vrātyaṃ caranti | iyaṃ vā aditis |
18.25.374.d: अप्रतिष्ठिता इव वा एते चरन्ति ये व्रात्यं चरन्ति । इयं वा अदितिस् ।
18.25.374.m: As if without a firm support indeed they wander who wander as Vrātyas. This [earth] indeed is Aditi.
They become firmly supported in this very [earth].

18.26.374.s: sa eṣa jyeṣṭhānām agniṣṭomas tasya catvāri ṣoḍaśāni dvau pavamānāv ubhe evācchāvākasya stotre
18.26.374.d: स एष ज्येष्ठानाम् अग्निष्टोमस् तस्य चत्वारि षोडशानि द्वौ पवमानाव् उभे एवाच्छावाकस्य स्तोत्रे
18.26.374.m: This is the agniṣṭoma of the senior [Vrātyas]. For it there are four sixteen-verse chants, two pavamāna chants, and both chants of the acchāvāka priest.
Being this very [rite], it is the ukthya of the junior [Vrātyas].

18.26.374.s: tasya ṣaṭ ṣoḍaśāni sarve pavamānāḥ sarvāṇy acchāvākasya stotrāṇi
18.26.374.d: तस्य षट् षोडशानि सर्वे पवमानाः सर्वाण्य् अच्छावाकस्य स्तोत्राणि
18.26.374.m: For it there are six sixteen-verse chants, all pavamāna chants, and all chants of the acchāvāka priest.

18.26.374.s: tena haitena maruta ījire teṣāṃ viṣṇu sthapatir āsa |
18.26.374.d: तेन हैतेन मरुत ईजिरे तेषां विष्णु स्थपतिर् आस ।
18.26.374.m: With this very [rite] the Maruts sacrificed. Viṣṇu was their leader.

18.26.374.s: atho haitena daivyā vrātyā ījire teṣāṃ budhaḥ saumya sthapatir āsa |
18.26.374.d: अथो हैतेन दैव्या व्रात्या ईजिरे तेषां बुधः सौम्य स्थपतिर् आस ।
18.26.374.m: Then indeed with this the divine Vrātyas sacrificed. Budha Saumya was their leader.

18.26.374.s: atho haitena kurubrahmaṇāṃ putrā ījire teṣām aupoditir gaupālāyano vaiyāghrapadya sthapatir āsa
18.26.374.d: अथो हैतेन कुरुब्रह्मणां पुत्रा ईजिरे तेषाम् औपोदितिर् गौपालायनो वैयाघ्रपद्य स्थपतिर् आस
18.26.374.m: Then indeed with this the sons of the Kuru brahmins sacrificed. Aupoditi Gaupālāyana Vaiyāghrapadya was their leader.
Having sacrificed with this, the Vrātyas marched toward the Pañcālas.

18.26.374.s: tān ha pitara ūcur mā putrakāḥ pañcālān yāsiṣṭopavādino vai pañcālā upa vo vadiṣyantīti
18.26.374.d: तान् ह पितर ऊचुर् मा पुत्रकाः पञ्चालान् यासिष्टोपवादिनो वै पञ्चाला उप वो वदिष्यन्तीति
18.26.374.m: Their fathers said to them: 'Sons, do not go to the Pañcālas. The Pañcālas are censurers; they will censure you.'

18.26.374.s: te ha keśino dālbhyasyopavasatham ājagmus tān ha śvo bhūte bahiṣpavamānam̐ sarpato 'nvālebhire pavitraṃ vai bahiṣpavamāna ātmānaṃ pavayiṣyāmaha iti vadantas |
18.26.374.d: ते ह केशिनो दाल्भ्यस्योपवसथम् आजग्मुस् तान् ह श्वो भूते बहिष्पवमानँ सर्पतो ऽन्वालेभिरे पवित्रं वै बहिष्पवमान आत्मानं पवयिष्यामह इति वदन्तस् ।
18.26.374.m: They came to the fast-day of Keśin Dālbhya. On the next day, they touched from behind those creeping to the bahiṣpavamāna chant, saying: 'The bahiṣpavamāna is indeed a purifier; we will purify ourselves.'

18.26.374.s: atha ha pañcāleṣu gandharvāyaṇo vāleya āgniveśyo 'nūcāna āsa
18.26.374.d: अथ ह पञ्चालेषु गन्धर्वायणो वालेय आग्निवेश्यो ऽनूचान आस
18.26.374.m: Now among the Pañcālas, Gandharvāyaṇa Vāleya Āgniveśya was learned in the Veda.

18.26.374.s: tān ha saha sarpataḥ papraccha ke sarpantīti
18.26.374.d: तान् ह सह सर्पतः पप्रच्छ के सर्पन्तीति
18.26.374.m: He asked them as they crept along together: 'Who are creeping?'

18.26.374.s: vayaṃ maruta iti teṣāṃ vaḥ ka sthapatir iti |
18.26.374.d: वयं मरुत इति तेषां वः क स्थपतिर् इति ।
18.26.374.m: 'We are the Maruts.' — 'Who is your leader?'

18.26.374.s: ahaṃ viṣṇur ity aupoditir gaupālāyano vaiyāghrapadyaḥ pratyuvāca
18.26.374.d: अहं विष्णुर् इत्य् औपोदितिर् गौपालायनो वैयाघ्रपद्यः प्रत्युवाच
18.26.374.m: 'I am Viṣṇu,' replied Aupoditi Gaupālāyana Vaiyāghrapadya.

18.26.374.s: yat kiṃ cakartha kas tac cacāretīti ha parokṣāvratam anunirdideśeti
18.26.374.d: यत् किं चकर्थ कस् तच् चचारेतीति ह परोक्षाव्रतम् अनुनिर्दिदेशेति
18.26.374.m: 'What have you done, who has wandered thus?' — thus indeed he pointed out the secret practice.

18.26.375.s: tān hovācāviduṣo va upāvādiṣmāpa vo hnumaha iti
18.26.375.d: तान् होवाचाविदुषो व उपावादिष्माप वो ह्नुमह इति
18.26.375.m: He said to them: 'Not knowing, we censured you; we make amends to you.'

18.26.375.s: pitā vai tat putrān upāvādīd iti hainam ūcuḥ pāpīyasī te prajā bhaviṣyatīti
18.26.375.d: पिता वै तत् पुत्रान् उपावादीद् इति हैनम् ऊचुः पापीयसी ते प्रजा भविष्यतीति
18.26.375.m: They said to him: 'A father indeed thus censured his sons; your offspring will become worse.'

18.26.375.s: tathā haivāsa tato ha vā etat pañcāleṣu gandharvāyaṇā vāleyā āgniveśyāḥ pāpāyitā iva
18.26.375.d: तथा हैवास ततो ह वा एतत् पञ्चालेषु गन्धर्वायणा वालेया आग्निवेश्याः पापायिता इव
18.26.375.m: And so indeed it was. Thence indeed the Gandharvāyaṇa Vāleya Āgniveśyas among the Pañcālas are, as it were, degraded.
It had formerly been a great family.

18.26.375.s: sa yo vrātyam upavaded evam evainam upavadet | atha yo vrātyo 'laṃ prativacanāya syād evam evainaṃ pratibrūyāt ||
18.26.375.d: स यो व्रात्यम् उपवदेद् एवम् एवैनम् उपवदेत् । अथ यो व्रात्यो ऽलं प्रतिवचनाय स्याद् एवम् एवैनं प्रतिब्रूयात् ॥
18.26.375.m: He who would censure a Vrātya should censure him in this very way; and the Vrātya who is capable of answering should answer him in this very way.

18.27.375.s: athāto bhāllavistomā ity ācakṣate trivṛd abhyāvarti pañcadaśam agniṣṭomasāma sarve ṣoḍaśāḥ pavamānāḥ
18.27.375.d: अथातो भाल्लविस्तोमा इत्य् आचक्षते त्रिवृद् अभ्यावर्ति पञ्चदशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम सर्वे षोडशाः पवमानाः
18.27.375.m: Now next they explain the Bhāllavistomas: a nine-verse stoma repeating, a fifteen-verse agniṣṭoma chant, all pavamāna chants sixteen-verse;

18.27.375.s: pañcadaśam abhyāvarti saptadaśam agniṣṭomasāma sarve ṣoḍaśāḥ pavamānāḥ
18.27.375.d: पञ्चदशम् अभ्यावर्ति सप्तदशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम सर्वे षोडशाः पवमानाः
18.27.375.m: a fifteen-verse stoma repeating, a seventeen-verse agniṣṭoma chant, all pavamāna chants sixteen-verse;

18.27.375.s: saptadaśam abhyāvartyekavim̐śam agniṣṭomasāma sarve ṣoḍaśāḥ pavamānās |
18.27.375.d: सप्तदशम् अभ्यावर्त्येकविँशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम सर्वे षोडशाः पवमानास् ।
18.27.375.m: a seventeen-verse stoma repeating, a twenty-one-verse agniṣṭoma chant, all pavamāna chants sixteen-verse;

18.27.375.s: ekavim̐śam abhyāvarti triṇavam agniṣṭomasāma sarve ṣoḍaśāḥ pavamānās
18.27.375.d: एकविँशम् अभ्यावर्ति त्रिणवम् अग्निष्टोमसाम सर्वे षोडशाः पवमानास्
18.27.375.m: a twenty-one-verse stoma repeating, a twenty-seven-verse agniṣṭoma chant, all pavamāna chants sixteen-verse;

18.27.375.s: triṇavam abhyāvarti trayastrim̐śam agniṣṭomasāma sarve ṣoḍaśāḥ pavamānās
18.27.375.d: त्रिणवम् अभ्यावर्ति त्रयस्त्रिँशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम सर्वे षोडशाः पवमानास्
18.27.375.m: a twenty-seven-verse stoma repeating, a thirty-three-verse agniṣṭoma chant, all pavamāna chants sixteen-verse;

18.27.375.s: trayastrim̐śam abhyāvarti triṇavam agniṣṭomasāma sarve ṣoḍaśāḥ pavamānās
18.27.375.d: त्रयस्त्रिँशम् अभ्यावर्ति त्रिणवम् अग्निष्टोमसाम सर्वे षोडशाः पवमानास्
18.27.375.m: a thirty-three-verse stoma repeating, a twenty-seven-verse agniṣṭoma chant, all pavamāna chants sixteen-verse;

18.27.375.s: triṇavam abhyāvarty ekavim̐śam agniṣṭomasāma sarve ṣoḍaśāḥ pavamānās |
18.27.375.d: त्रिणवम् अभ्यावर्त्य् एकविँशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम सर्वे षोडशाः पवमानास् ।
18.27.375.m: a twenty-seven-verse stoma repeating, a twenty-one-verse agniṣṭoma chant, all pavamāna chants sixteen-verse;

18.27.375.s: ekavim̐śam abhyāvarti saptadaśam agniṣṭomasāma sarve ṣoḍaśāḥ pavamānāḥ
